多肉植物||5.content:
Aeonium canariense - 千种多肉植物图鉴 - 梦桑阁

 

 

Aeonium canariense

 CANARIENSE (L.) Webb & Berthelot, 1841

Synonym :

异名:

Sempervivum canariense L. (1753)

Section Patinaria

帕蒂娜(音译)组

Distribution : Canary Islands

分布:加那利群岛

4 varieties :

4个变种:

Aeonium canariense var. canariense

Aeonium canariense var. palmense  (Webb ex Christ) H.-Y. Liu, 1989

Aeonium canariense var. subplanum (Praeger) H.-Y. Liu, 1989

Aeonium canariense var. virgineum  (Webb ex Christ) H.-Y. Liu, 1989

P.S.该种为原始种,习性与变种相近,本帖主要介绍其变种.

-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

CANARIENSE var. CANARIENSE 香炉盘

即香炉盘.

Synonyms :

异名:

Sempervivum latifolium  Salisbury (1796)

Aeonium giganteum  Webb ex Christ (1888)

Sempervivum canariense ssp. typicum  Burchard (1929)

Distribution : Canary Islands (Northern Tenerife); 600 - l300 m.

分布:加那利群岛(特内里费岛北部);海拔600 - 1300m地区.

Description (according to IHSP, 2003) :

描述(根据IHSP,2003):

Perennials.

多年生.

Stems stout, smooth.

枝干粗壮而光滑.

Rosette solitary or caespitose, 10 - 60 cm in diameter, cup-shaped, inner leaves ± erect.

莲座状叶,植株单生或群生,直径10 - 60cm,叶呈杯状,生长点附近叶片直立.

Leaves 6 - 35 x 3 - 12 cm, 3 - 10 mm thick, obovate to oblanceolate, apically rounded, mucronate, basally cuneate, velvety with glandular hairs 0.7 - 1 (-1.4) mm (5 - 15 hairs per mm2), margin occasionally slightly undulate, green, occasionally reddish or yellowish.

叶6 - 35片,长3 - 12cm,厚3 - 10mm,卵形或倒披针形,先端圆形,有短尖(注:新叶尖,生长之后叶尖会逐渐变为卵圆,不过短尖仍会保留.),基部楔形,叶似天鹅绒般,有0.7 - 1(1.4)mm长的腺毛(每mm2大约5 - 15根),叶缘偶尔会呈波浪状,叶通常绿色,颜色偶尔会偏红或偏黄.

Inflorescences 30 - 45 x 20 - 30 cm, peduncle 12 - 30 cm, leafy, pedicels 0.5 - 5 mm, pubescent.

花序30 - 45枝,长20 - 30cm,总花梗 12 - 30cm,十分繁茂,花梗0.5 - 5mm,被绒毛.

Flowers 8- to 10-merous, sepals glandular-pubescen, petals 7 - 9 x 1.5 - 2 mm, narrowly elliptic, whitish-green, filaments glabrous.

花基数8 - 10,绒毛萼片,花瓣 7 - 9片,长1.5 - 2mm,狭椭圆形,白色,或绿色,花丝无毛.

Cytology : n=18

染色体:n=18

Photos Jens Kumke

生长季的Var. canariense

Photos Eric Barbier

©Dionysos en Olerdola

©Luis Borja

-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

CANARIENSE var. PALMENSE (Webb ex Christ) H.-Y. Liu, 1989 隐霜莲

该品种成株后,由于叶面被绒毛,时常有覆霜之感.故拟名隐霜莲.

Synonyms :

异名:

Aeonium palmense Webb ex Christ (1888)  / Sempervivum palmense  (Webb ex Christ) Christ (1888)

Sempervivum xchristii Praeger (1925)  / Sempervivum canariense ssp. christii (Praeger) Burchard (1929)

Sempervivum canariense ssp. longithyrsum  Burchard (1929) / Aeonium longithyrsum (Burchard) Sventenius (1969)

Sempervivum propinquum  Praeger (1932)

Distribution : Canary Islands (La Palma, N Hierro); to 1200 m.

分布:加那利群岛(拉帕尔马,耶罗岛N地区);海拔1200m内地区.

Differs from var. canariense :

与Var. canariense(香炉盘)的不同:

Rosette cupshaped.

莲座杯状.

Leaves velvety with glandular hairs 0.3 - 0.5 (- 1) mm (30 - 60 hairs per mm2), viscid, margin often strongly undulate.

叶似天鹅绒般,有0.3 - 0.5(-1)mm长的短密绒毛(每mm2大约30 - 60根),叶有粘性,叶缘常呈强烈波浪状.

Inflorescences 40 - 60 x 15 - 30 cm.

花序40 - 60枝,长15 - 30cm.

Flowers 8- to 10-merous, petals 7 - 10 x 2 - 3 mm, lanceolate, yellowish-green.

花基数8 - 10,花瓣7 - 10片,长2 - 3mm,披针形,黄绿色.

Cytology : n=18

染色体:n=18

所谓隐霜

Photos Jacquie Koutsoudis, SA 

4年植株的迷人大波浪

Photos Eric Barbier

-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

CANARIENSE var. SUBPLANUM (Praeger) H.-Y.Liu, 1989 软绒盘

根据其特点,拟名软绒盘.

Synonyms :

异名:

Aeonium subplanum  Praeger (1928)

Sempervivum canariense ssp. latifolium  Burchard (1929)

Distribution : Canary Islands (Gomera); 200 - 1000 m.

分布:加那利群岛(戈梅拉岛);海拔200 - 1000m地区.

Differs from var. canariense  :

与Var. canariense(香炉盘)的不同:

Rosette often flattish.

莲座常持平.

Leaves velvety with glandular hairs 0.3 - 1mm (5 – 15 hairs per mm2).

叶似天鹅绒般,有0.3 - 1mm长的短密腺毛(每mm2大约5 - 15根).

Inflorescences 18 - 30 x 15 - 28 cm.

花序18 - 30枝,长15 - 28cm

Flowers 10- to 12-merous, petals 7 - 10 x 2 - 2.5 mm, lanceolate.

花基数10 - 12,花瓣7 - 10片,长2 - 2.5mm,披针形

Cytology : n=18

染色体:n=18

注:Aeonium canariense var. subplanum有香味.

Photos Ray Stephenson

Photos Jens Kumke

©Liz21UK

©Universität Göttingen

-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

CANARIENSE var. VIRGINEUM (Webb ex Christ) H.-Y.Liu, 1989 加那利少女

"virgineum"来自于拉丁语"Virgo",意为少女,结合其原生地,拟名加那利少女.

Synonyms :

异名:

Aeonium virgineum  Webb ex Christ (1888)

Sempervivum virgineum  (Webb ex Christ) Christ (1888)

Sempervivum canariense ssp. virgineum  (Webb ex Christ) Burchard (1929)

Distribution : Canary Islands (N Gran Canaria); to 1000 m.

分布:加那利群岛(大加那利岛N地区);海拔1000m内地区.

Differs from var. canariense :

与Var. canariense(香炉盘)的不同:

Rosettes cup-shaped.

莲座杯状(注:植栽观察家里的植株,认为较大的不同是生长点状况,以及叶形.)

Leaves velvety with glandular hairs 0.6 - 0.9 mm (10 - 20 hairs per mm2), margin occasionally undulate.

叶似天鹅绒般,有0.6 - 0.9mm长的短密腺毛(每mm2大约10 -  20根).叶缘偶尔呈波浪状(注:极少).

Inflorescences 15 - 45 x 12 - 30 cm.

花序15 - 45枝,长12 - 30cm

Flowers 6- to 9-merous, petals 7 - 8.5 x 1.5 - 2 mm, lanceolate,

多肉植物||6.title: Aeonium davidbramwellii 寒月夜 - 千种多肉植物图鉴 - 梦桑阁
多肉植物||6.content:
Aeonium davidbramwellii 寒月夜 - 千种多肉植物图鉴 - 梦桑阁

 

 

Aeonium davidbramwellii 寒月夜

 DAVIDBRAMWELLII H.-Y.Liu, 1989 寒月夜

"davidbramwellii"来源于该物种的发现者——英国荣誉植物学家大卫·布拉姆韦尔(David Bramwell 1942),他在加那利群岛的大加那利岛Tafira Alta发现了这个物种.考虑到其变种花叶寒月夜的存在,拟名为]寒月夜.

©Liz21UK

Synonym :

异名:

Aeonium ciliatum ssp. praegeri  Bañares (1990)

Section Leuconium

琉康尼昂(音译)组

Distribution : Canary Islands (La Palma); to 1000 m.

分布:加那利群岛(拉帕尔马岛);海拔1000m内地区

Description (according to IHSP, 2003) :

描述(根据IHSP,2003):

Perennial few-branched subshrubs to 1 m.

多年生少分枝亚灌木,高度可达1m左右.

Branches ascending, 7 - 25 mm , glabrous, reticulate.

分支向上生长,直径7 - 25mm,无毛,茎干呈网格状.

Rosette 6 - 22 cm in diameter, rather flattish.

莲座直径6 - 22cm,叶尖持平.

Leaves 3 - 12 x 2 - 4 cm, 2 – 6 mm thick, obovate to oblanceolate-spatulate, apically acuminate, basally attenuate or cuneate, puberulent, margin with conical cilia ( ≤ 0.5 mm), dark green to yellowish-green, often reddish or brownish variegated along margin.

叶长3 - 12cm,宽2 - 4cm.厚2 - 5mm,倒卵形至倒披针匙形,先端渐尖,基部衰减或楔形,被微柔毛,边缘具圆锥形的纤毛(≤0.5mm),叶呈深绿色至黄绿色,常带红色或褐色的沿缘杂色.

Inflorescences ± ovoid, 10 - 35 x 8 - 25 cm, peduncle 5 - 20 cm long, pedicels 1 - 3 mm, puberulent.

花絮大致呈卵形,高10 - 35cm,宽8 - 25cm,总花梗长5 - 20cm,花梗长1 - 3mm,被微柔毛.

Flowers 6- to 8-merous, sepals puberulent, petals 6.5 - 9 x 1.5 - 2.5 mm, lanceolate, acuminate, whitish, generally greenish variegated, filaments puberulent.

花基数6 - 8,萼片被微柔毛,花瓣长6.5 - 9mm,宽1.5 - 2.5mm,披针形,渐尖,白色,常有绿色掺杂.花丝被微柔毛.

Cytology : 2n=36

染色体:2n=38(即n=18)

Easily confused with A. ]ciliatum(Bañares Baudet & Catalina León 1997).

容易与Aeonium ciliatum混淆.

Zusung的植株.家庭种植的理想状态.

©Zusung

©Marijn van den Brink

dacidbramwelii在原生地(生长季):

©Universität Göttingen

Photos Dr. Michael Schwerdtfeger

(P.S.Dr. Michael Schwerdtfeger似乎就是Flickr的Universität Göttingen,一位大学教授.)

Aeonium davidbramwellii的花.

©limonium64

'Sunburst'(灿烂/花叶寒月夜)

Most probably a variegated cultivar of A. davidbramwellii.

较可能是Aeonium davidbramwellii的锦叶变种.

Incorrectly distributed by ISI as Aeonium decorum 'Sunburst'. Rudolf Schulz writes : "… the reversion of this plant is very much like A. davidbramwellii, with rosettes growing up to 400 mm in diameter, well beyond anything that A. decorum could manage" .

错误地被ISI作为Aeonium decorum 'Sunburst'.鲁道夫·舒尔茨写道:"......这种植物的退化植株非常像Aeonium davidbramwellii,莲座能够成长到400mm的直径,远远超出任何一株Aeonium decorum能够到达的大小.

染色体:2n =36

©Beadmobile

©Colleen Sharmat

花叶寒月夜的缀化植株:

©FarOutFlora

Photo Noelene Tomlinson

Aeonium davidbramwellii寒月夜,是硬叶系Aeonium中较有代表性的,种子发芽率较为高,抗性亦较好,并且随着季节轮转的变化非常大,有时很难看出它们是一个品种.

多肉植物||7.content:
Aeonium decorum 花钿 - 千种多肉植物图鉴 - 梦桑阁

 

 

Aeonium decorum 花钿

 DECORUM Webb ex Bolle, 1859 花钿

(Wikipedia:epithet Latin meaning "decorative")

"decorum"一词来自拉丁语,意为"装饰性",故结合其外形拟名为花钿(diàn)(P.S.在古代,女性用簪钗来绾住头发,而后将花钿直接插入绾好的发髻中,装饰发髻.)

©Liz21UK

Synonym :

异名:

Sempervivum decorum  (Webb ex Bolle) Christ (1888)

Distribution : Canary Islands (Gomera, Tenerife); 100 - 900 m.

分布:加那利群岛(戈梅拉岛,特内里费岛);海拔100 - 900m地区

Description (according to IHSP, 2003) :

描述(根据IHSP,2003):

Perennial densely branched shrublets to 60 cm.

多年生小型灌木,枝杈较为密集,高度可达60cm左右.

Branches  ascending or pendent, tortuous, 5 - 8 mm diameter, glabrous, reticulate.

枝干上升或下垂,茎干曲折,直径5 - 8mm,无毛,网状.

Rosettes  5 - 10 cm in diameter, rather flattish.

莲座状叶直径5 - 10cm,叶尖持平.

Leaves  2.5 - 5 x 1 - 1.5 cm, 2.5 - 4.5 mm thick, obovate to oblanceolate, apically acuminate, basally cuneate, glaucous, puberulent, margin with few scattered cilia (≤ 0.5 mm), dark green to yellowish-green, often reddish variegated along margin.

叶片长2.5 - 5cm,宽1 - 1.5cm,厚2.5 - 4.5mm,倒卵形至倒披针形,先端渐尖,基部楔形.叶被白霜,被微柔毛,边缘有一些零星的纤毛(≤0.5mm),叶呈深绿色至黄绿色,常带红色,叶缘则常呈杂色.

Inflorescences lax, cylindrical, 8 - 30 x 8 - 20 cm, peduncle 10 - 30 cm, pedicels 2 - 10 mm, puberulent.

花序疏松,圆柱形,高8 - 30cm,宽8 - 20cm,总花梗长10 - 30cm,花梗长2 - 10mm,被微柔毛.

Flowers  6- to 8-merous, sepals puberulent, petals 7 - 8 x 2 - 2.5 mm, lanceolate, acuminate, whitish, often pinkish or reddish variegated, filaments sparsely puberulent.

花基数6 - 8,萼片被微柔毛,花瓣长7 - 8mm,宽2 - 2.5mm,披针形,渐尖,白色,常有粉色,红色混杂其中.花丝疏生柔毛.

Cytology : n=18

染色体:n=18

Recently also reported from Tenerife ( Hernández 1998).

(埃尔南德斯 1998):较近在特内里费岛亦有发现.

©Universität Göttingen

P.S.这个貌似是一个变种,但是种植者亦无法确定.

©Virata33

decorum在原生地.

©Liz21UK

decorum的花

Photos Ray Stephenson

苗期Aeonium decorum

©adrien2008

Photos Jens Kumke

Aeonium decorum的花序

©Manuel M.Ramos

©Marco Borg

©A.Banu

The same plant after summer dormancy, Aug. 2012 :

同一株植物,在夏季休眠后的样子(2012.8):

Photos Eric Barbier

From:lapshin

Aeonium decorum花钿,拥有小巧精致的莲座和优雅的株型,其艳丽的色彩更是为她的魅力加分,薄而尖的叶有着不输于大型种的气势,正如花钿,看上去精致可人,质地却坚硬无比.也是很棒的杂交亲本.

多肉植物||8.content:
Aeonium glandulosum 盃莲 - 千种多肉植物图鉴 - 梦桑阁

Aeonium glandulosum 盃莲

GLANDULOSUM (Aiton) Webb & Berthelot, 1840 盃莲

©cactiphobia
 Synonyms :
 异名:
 Sempervivum glandulosum  Aiton (1789)
 Aeonium meyerheimii Bolle (1859) / Sempervivum meyerheimii  (Bolle) Murray (1899)
 Sempervivum patina Lowe (1864)
 Distribution : N Madeira  (Deserta Grande), to 1500 m.
 分布:北部马德拉群岛(大德塞塔岛),海拔1500m以下地区.
 Description (according to IHSP, 2003) :
 描述(根据IHSP,2003):
 Biennial to perennial, single or occasionally offsetting rosette plants.
 两年生植物,通常独生,有时生侧芽.
 Stems stout, smooth.
 茎粗壮,光滑.
 Rosette 12 – 40 cm in diameter, cup-shaped.

 叶长6 - 11cm,宽3 - 8cm,厚3 - 5mm,倒卵形或倒披针形,被微柔毛,先端锐尖,叶形短尖,基部楔形,叶缘缘具珠状纤毛(约0.6mm).
 Inflorescence much wider than tall, 8 – 25 x 12 – 40 cm, peduncle 2 – 10 cm, leafy, pedicels 3 – 18 mm, glandular-pubescent.

 Flowers 8- to 13-merous, sepals glandular-pubescent, petals 7 – 11 x 3 – 4 mm, lanceolate, acute, pale yellow.

多肉植物||9.content:
Aeonium glutinosum 相思染 - 千种多肉植物图鉴 - 梦桑阁

 

 

Aeonium glutinosum 相思染

 GLUTINOSUM (Aiton) Webb & Berthelot, 1840 相思染

"glutinoum"应来源于拉丁语,意为有粘性的.(英语中存在"glutinous"adj.粘性的;胶状的.这个词)古往今来,较是相思稠,相思染叶,岂能不粘:),恰好植栽非常喜欢龚琳娜的《相思染》,因此拟名为相思染.

©Universität Göttingen

Synonym :

异名:

Sempervivum glutinosum  Aiton (1789)

Section Patinaria

帕缇娜雅(音译)组

Distribution : Nothern Madeira (Deserta Grande); to 300 (rarely 1700).

分布:北部马德拉群岛(大德塞塔岛);海拔300m以下区域(事实上1700m内均有分布).

Description (according to IHSP, 2003) :

描述(根据IHSP,2003):

Perennial caespitose or slightly shrubby rosette plants.

多年生丛生或灌木状生莲座状植物.

Branches 7 - 20 mm in diameter, glabrous, sticky, smooth.

茎干直径7 - 20mm,无毛,粘,光滑.

Rosettes 12 - 22 cm in diameter, cup-shaped.

莲座直径12 - 22cm,杯形.

Leaves 7 - 12 x 3 – 5.5 cm, 2 - 4.5 mm thick, obovate-spatulate, apically acute, basally cuneate, glabrate,margin with very few to numerous straight to curved cilia (≤ 0.5 mm), pale to dull green, usually with brownish stripes along the midrib and near the apex.

叶长7 - 12cm,宽3 - 5.5cm,厚2 - 4.5mm,倒卵状匙形,先端锐尖,基部楔形,无毛.边缘有或多或少,或直或弯曲的纤毛(≤0.5mm),叶   呈白到暗绿色,通常沿中脉和叶尖附近分布有褐色条纹.

Inflorescences very lax, sticky, 15 - 40 x 15 - 30 cm, peduncle 10 - 25 cm long, pedicels 2 - 10 mm, puberulent.

松散状花序,粘,高15 - 40cm,宽15 - 30cm,总花梗长10 - 25cm,花梗长2 - 10mm,被微柔毛.

Flowers 8- to 10-merous, sepals puberulent, petals 5 - 7 x 2 - 3 mm, ovate to lanceolate, yellow, lower face with reddish lines, filaments glabrous.

花基数8 - 10,萼片被微柔毛,花瓣长5 - 7mm,宽2 - 3mm,卵形至披针形,呈黄色,下表面有淡红色的线条,花丝无毛.

Cytology : n=18

染色体:n=18

Aeonium gomerense 戈梅拉之彤 - 千种多肉植物图鉴 - 梦桑阁

 

 

Aeonium gomerense 戈梅拉之彤

 GOMERENSE (Praeger) Praeger, 1928 戈梅拉之彤

"gomerense"意为:来自戈梅拉岛,加那利群岛.结合其低温时叶缘泛红的特点,拟名为戈梅拉之彤(tóng).

©Universität Göttingen

Synonym :

异名:

Sempervivum gomerense  Praeger (1925)

Section Leuconium

琉康尼昂(音译)组

Distribution : Canary Islands (Gomera); 500 - 1100 m.

分布:加那利群岛(戈梅拉岛);海拔500 - 1100m地区.

Description (according to IHSP, 2003) :

描述(根据IHSP,2003):

Perennial loosely branched subshrubs to 2 m.

多年生亚灌木,分支松散,成株可达2m.

Branches ascending or pendent, 3 - 15 mm in diameter, glabrous, reticulate.

枝干上升或下垂,直径3 - 15mm,无毛,呈网状.

Rosette 10 - 28 cm in diameter, rather flattish.

莲座直径10 - 28cm,叶大致持平.

Leaves 5 - 14 x 2.5 - 4 cm, 3 - 7 mm thick, obovate to oblanceolate, apically acuminate, basally cuneate, glabrate, slightly glaucous, margin with ± straight cilia (0.5 - 1 mm), green, often reddish variegated along the margin.

叶长5 - 14cm,宽2.5 - 4cm,厚3 - 6mm,倒卵形至倒披针形,先端渐尖,基部楔形,叶平滑,稍被白粉,叶缘时有纤毛(0.5 - 1mm),叶呈绿色,叶缘常带有斑斓的红色.

Inflorescences ± ovoid, 15 - 40 x 10 - 30 cm, peduncle 10 - 20 cm, pedicels 2 - 6 mm, glabrous.

花序大致呈卵形,高15 - 40cm,宽10 - 31cm,总花梗长10 - 20cm,花梗长2 - 6mm,无毛.

Flowers 7- to 9-merous, sepals glabrous, petals 8 - 10 x 1.5 - 2 mm, lanceolate, acuminate, whitish, lower face greenish variegated, filaments glabrous.

花基数7 - 9,萼片无毛,花瓣长8 - 10mm,宽1.5 - 2mm,披针形,渐尖,发白,下表面呈淡绿色为主的杂色,花丝无毛.

多肉植物||11.content:
Aeonium goochiae 古琦 - 千种多肉植物图鉴 - 梦桑阁

Aeonium goochiae 古琦

GOOCHIAE Webb & Berthelot, 1840 古琦
 For Mrs. Gooch, maiden name of the mother of 19th century English naturalist and geologist Philip B. Webb
 以古琦女士命名,她是19​​世纪英国博物学家和地质学家菲利普B.韦伯(Philip B. Webb)的母亲.为了表示尊重,以原名音译.(另注:传统音译为"古奇",但"琦"字意为美玉,美好,在中国,女名qí音多用"琦"字.)
 P.S.韦伯先生是Aeonium属十分多品种的发现人.

©carlesjbox
 Synonyms :
 异名:
 Sempervivum goochiae  (Webb & Berthelot) Christ (1888) / Sempervivum tortuosum var. goochiae  (Webb & Berthelot) Kuntze (1891) / Aldasorea goochiae  (Webb & Berthelot) hort. ex Haage & Schmidt (1930)
 Section Chrysocome
 克里斯康(音译)组
 Distribution : Canary Islands (Nothern La Palma); 100 - 700 m.
 分布:加那利群岛(拉帕尔马岛北部);海拔100 - 700m地区.
 Description (according to IHSP, 2003) :
 描述(根据IHSP,2003):
 Perennial densely branched shrublets to 40 cm tall.
 多年生灌木,密生,成株高度可达40cm.
 Branches 2 - 10 mm in diameter, pubescent, slightly viscid, smooth, without reticulations.
 分枝直径2 - 10mm,被短柔毛,略有粘性,光滑,无网纹.
 Rosettes 3 - 12 cm in diameter, flattish, inner leaves ± erect.
 莲座直径3 - 12cm,大致持平,内叶偶有直立.
 Leaves 1.5 - 5 x 1.5 - 2.5 cm, 1 - 2 mm thick, elliptic or circular, apically rounded or acute, retuse, basally cuneate, pubescent, viscid, pale green to yellowish green, occasionally reddish variegated.
 叶长1.5 - 5cm,宽1.2 - 2.5cm,厚1 - 2mm,椭圆形或圆形,先端圆形或锐尖,微凹,基部楔形,被短柔毛,具有粘性.呈淡绿色至黄绿色,有时带红色的杂色.
 Inflorescences cymose panicles 2 - 5 x 3 - 11 cm, commonly 10- to 45-flowered, peduncle 1 - 2 cm, pedicels 1 - 15 mm, puberulent.
 聚伞状圆锥花序,高2 - 5cm,宽3 - 11cm,通常有10 - 45朵花,花序梗长1 - 2cm,花梗长1 - 15mm,被微柔毛.
 Flowers 7- to 8-merous, sepals glandular-pubescent, petals 5 - 7 x 1 - 2 mm, oblanceolate, acute, very pale yellow or whitish, median part often pinkish variegated, filaments glabrous.
 花基数7 - 8,萼片被腺柔毛,花瓣长5 - 7mm.宽1 - 2mm,倒披针形,尖锐.呈淡黄色或白色,中间部分常有粉红色的杂色,花丝无毛.
 Cytology : 2n = 36
 染色体:2n=36 即 n=18

©carlesjbox

多肉植物||12.content:
Aeonium gorgoneum 晓之埃 - 千种多肉植物图鉴 - 梦桑阁

 

 

Aeonium gorgoneum 晓之埃

 GORGONEUM J.A.Schmidt, 1852 晓之埃

"gorgoneum"应该源自拉丁语词干"gorgonias"指"Gorgades(现今的佛得角群岛)".根据其叶面被粉,冬季鲜红的特点拟名为晓之埃,意为清晨暖阳所洒下的尘埃.

From:Wikimedia Commons

Synonym :

异名:

Sempervivum gorgoneum (J.A.Schmidt) J.A.Schmidt ex Coutinho (1914)

Section Aeonium

莲花掌组

Distribution : Cape Verde Islands (San Antonio, San Nicolau, San Vicente); ± 300 - 1300 m.

分布:佛得角群岛(圣安东尼奥岛,圣尼谷岛,圣维森特岛,);海拔300 - 1300m地区.

Description (according to IHSP, 2003) :

描述(根据IHSP,2003):

Perennial branched subshrubs to 2 m.

多年生丛生亚灌木,成株高度可达2m.

Branches ascending, usually in groups, 5 - 15 mm in diameter, glabrous, smooth; Ros 9 - 20 cm in diameter, centre rather flattened with young leaves tightly appressed to each other.

分枝上升,通常群生,茎直径5 - 16mm,无毛,光滑;莲座直径9 - 20cm,中心扁平,生长点附近叶片相互紧贴.

Leaves 5 - 10 x 1.5 - 3 cm, 3 - 6 mm thick, oblanceolate-spatulate, apically acute or acuminate, mucronate, basally cuneate, strongly glaucous, glabrous, margin with straight or forward-curved cilia (≤ 0.5 mm), green, often reddish variegated along margin and midrib.

叶长5 - 10cm,宽1.5 - 3cm,厚3 - 6mm,叶呈倒披针形,匙形,先端急尖或渐尖.叶短尖,基部楔形,被厚白霜,无毛,缘具直或向前弯曲的纤毛(≤ 0.5mm),叶通常呈绿色,常有以红色为主的杂色沿中脉和叶缘分布.

Inflorescences pyramidal, 5 - 8 x 7 - 10 cm,  peduncle 5 - 8 cm,  pedicels 1 - 8 mm, glabrous.

锥形花序,高5 - 8cm,宽7 - 10cm,总花梗5 - 8cm,花梗长1 - 8mm,无毛.

Flowers 8- to 10-merous,  sepals glabrous,  petals 5 - 6 x 1 - 1.5 mm, lanceolate, acuminate, yellow, reddish variegated, filaments glabrous.

花基数8 - 10,萼片无毛,花瓣长5 - 6mm,宽1 - 1.5mm,披针形,渐尖,呈黄色,有红色等杂色,花丝无毛.

Cytology : 2n=36

染色体:2n=36 即n=18

Description (according to IHSP, 2003) :

Perennial, unbranched or rarely few-branched, monocarpic subshrubs to 1.5m.

多年生亚灌木,少分枝或无分枝,果后死亡,成株可达1.5m.

Branches ascending, 20 - 45 mm in diameter, glabrous, reticulate.

分枝上升,直径20 - 45mm,无毛,呈网状.

Leaves 8 - 30 x 5 - 8 cm, 3 - 7 mm thick, obovate or oblanceolate, apically acute, caudate and often recurved, basally cuneate, strongly glaucous, glabrate, margin with slightly curved cilia (1 - 2 mm), green, with reddish or pinkish variegated margin.

叶长8-30cm,宽5-8cm,厚3-7mm,倒卵状披针形,顶部尖,尾状核,通常下弯,基部楔形,被厚白霜,光滑,边缘具稍弯曲的纤毛(1-2mm),呈绿色,通常有红色或粉红色的杂色.

Inflorescences dome-shaped, 15 - 50 x 12 – 50 cm, peduncle 5 - 25 cm, pedicels 2 - 6 mm, puberulent.

花序圆顶形,高15-50cm.宽12-50cm,花序梗5-25cm,花梗长2-6mm,被微柔毛.

Flowers 6- to 9-merous, sepals puberulent, petals 7 - 9 x 1.5 - 2 mm, lanceolate, acuminate, whitish, median part often pinkish variegated, filaments puberulent.

花基数6 - 9,萼片被微柔毛,花瓣长7.9mm,宽1.5 - 2mm,披针形,渐尖,白色,正中通常杂有色粉红色.花丝被微柔毛.

多肉植物||14.content:
Aeonium korneliuslemsii 瑾悬山 - 千种多肉植物图鉴 - 梦桑阁

 

 

Aeonium korneliuslemsii 瑾悬山

 KORNELIUSLEMSII H.-Y. Liu, 1989 瑾悬山

"瑾"为美玉名,代指其色;"悬山"是中式建筑的一种屋顶,其特征是檩木出梢,恰似叶尖形.故拟名瑾悬山.

Photos Ray Stephenson

Section Aeonium

莲花掌组

Distribution : South Western Morocco

分布:西南摩洛哥

Description (according to IHSP, 2003) :

描述(根据IHSP,2003):

Perennial rather few-branched subshrubs to 1.5m.

多年生少分枝亚灌木,成株可达1.5m.

Branches ± erect to ascending, often in groups, 10 - 20 mm in diameter, glabrous, smooth.

分枝直立上升,常成群,茎直径10 - 20mm,无毛,光滑.

Rosettes 5 - 17 cm in diameter, centre flattened with young inner leaves thightly appressed to each other.

莲座直径5 - 18cm,生长点附近平坦,新叶相互紧贴.

Leaves 4 - 9 x 2 - 3 cm, 1.5 - 3 mm thick, obovate or obovate-spatulate, apically truncate or rounded, basally cuneate, puberulent, margin with straight or curved cilia (0.4 - 1 mm), pale green to yellowish-green.

叶长4 - 9cm,宽2 - 3cm,厚1.5 - 3mm,叶倒卵形或倒卵状匙形,先端截形或圆形,基部楔形,被微柔毛,边缘具直的或弯曲的纤毛(0.4 - 1mm),叶片呈淡绿色至黄绿色.

Inflorescences 5 - 20 x 5 - 18 cm, peduncle 10 - 13 cm long, pedicels 3 - 8 mm, puberulent.

花序高5 - 20cm,宽5 - 19cm,总花梗长10 - 14cm,花梗长3 - 8mm,被微柔毛.

Flowers 7- to 9-merous, sepals sparsely puberulent to puberulent, petals 4.5 - 6 x 1.5 - 2.5 mm, elliptic, acute, occasionally emarginate, yellow, filaments glabrous.

花基数7 - 9,萼片疏生柔毛到微柔毛,花瓣长4.5 - 6mm,宽1.5 - 2.5mm,椭圆形,尖锐,有时微凹,呈黄色,花丝无毛.

Cytology : 2n=36

染色体:2n=36 即 n=18

©Coffee Obsessive

Photos Ray Stephenson

From:Wikipedia

野外状态下Aeonium korneliuslemsii

From:cutcaster

休眠时期状态

From:RP

野境下的Aeonium korneliuslemsii

Photos Jean-André Audissous

Aeonium korneliuslemsii 瑾悬山 是一款相当低调的Aeonium,其不具有辨识度的外形成为了硬伤,但事实上,其叶片的质感远胜于与其极其相似的Aeonium arboreum 一脉,并且在Aeonium组中是为数不多的叶被毛品种,这些都决定了他会是一个相当出色的亲本!

多肉植物||15.content:
Aeonium lancerottense 刃之舞 - 千种多肉植物图鉴 - 梦桑阁

 

 

Aeonium lancerottense 刃之舞

 LANCEROTTENSE (Praeger) Praeger, 1928 兰萨/刃之舞

"lancerottense"意为"Of or from Lanzarote, Canary Islands(源自兰萨罗特岛,加那利群岛.)"以其叶为倒披针形(oblanceolate)拟名刃之舞,另音译一名兰萨.

From:wikimedia

Synonym :

异名:

Sempervivum lancerottense Praeger (1925)

Section Aeonium

莲花掌组

Distribution : Canary Islands (Lanzarote); 200 - 600 m.

分布:加那利群岛(兰萨罗特岛);海拔200 - 600m.

Description (according to IHSP, 2003) :

描述(根据IHSP,2003):

Perennial densely branched subshrubs to 60 cm.

多年生亚灌木,易群生,成株可达60cm.

Branches ascending, 7 - 15 mm in diameter, glabrous, reticulate.

分枝上升,直径7 - 15mm,无毛,呈网状.

Rosettes 10 - 18 cm in diameter, rather flattish.

莲座直径10 - 18cm,叶尖持平.

Leaves 5 - 9 x 1.5 - 4 cm, 3 - 6 mm thick, obovate- or oblanceolate-spatulate, apically acute, caudate, basally cuneate, glaucous, glabrate, margin with some wrinkled cilia in the upper part, green to yellowish-green, often reddish variegated along margin and at the apex.

叶长5 - 9cm,宽1.5 - 4cm,厚3 - 6mm,叶呈倒卵形或倒披针形,匙形,先端急尖,尾状,基部楔形,叶被白霜,光滑,边缘有一些起皱的纤毛,叶呈绿色至黄绿色,沿微和尖顶常有杂色.

Inflorescences dome-shaped, 8 - 30 x 8 - 25 cm, peduncle 6 - 20 cm, pedicels 1 - 3.5 mm, glabrous.

圆顶形花序,高8 - 30cm,宽8 - 26cm,总花梗长6 - 20cm,花梗长1 - 3.5mm,无毛.

Flowers 7- to 8-merous, sepals puberulent to glabrate, petals 6 - 9 x 1 - 1.5 mm, lanceolate, acuminate, whitish, median part pinkish variegated, filaments glabrous.

花基数7 - 8,萼片被微柔毛到光滑,花瓣长6 - 9mm,宽1 - 1.5mm,披针形,渐尖,白色,花瓣中心有以粉红色为主的杂色,花丝无毛.

Cytology : n=18

染色体:n=18

Photos Ray Stephenson

From:Google

Haria, Lanzarote

哈里亚,兰萨罗特岛.

Photos Eduardo Carbonell

©Evolutionibus

©floradecanarias

©Fotografía de Naturaleza de Paco Moreno Gámez

©sftrajan

盛开的兰萨`刃之舞

©Lanzarote Active Club

正在开放的Aeonium lancerottense

©lanzarote rural

©terraincognita

Aeonium lancerottense 刃之舞 是Aeonium中十分有特色的品种,其鲜嫩的叶色和其刀刃般锋利的叶形形成了鲜明的对比,并且其花开时的盛状十分有观赏性,值得收藏.

多肉植物||16.title: Aeonium leucoblepharum 冬炎 - 千种多肉植物图鉴 - 梦桑阁
多肉植物||16.content:
Aeonium leucoblepharum 冬炎 - 千种多肉植物图鉴 - 梦桑阁

 

 

Aeonium leucoblepharum 冬炎

 LEUCOBLEPHARUM Webb ex A. Richard, 1848 冬炎

"leucoblepharum"意为"From the Greek leukos (white) and blepharis (eyelash); for the thin white leaf margins(来自希腊语.leukos(白色)和blepharis(睫毛);薄白叶缘.)"叶缘薄白,恰似冬季萌霜,而其叶火红,因此拟名为冬炎.

©Liz21UK

Synonyms :

异名:

Sempervivum leucoblepharum (Webb ex A. Richard) Hutchison & E. A. Bruce (1941)

Sempervivum chrysanthum  Hochstetter ex Britten (1871) / Aeonium chrysanthum  (Hochstetter ex Britten) A. Berger (1930)

Sempervivum chrysanthum var. glabrum  Chiovenda (1919)

Sempervivum chrysanthum var. glandulosum  Chiovenda (1919) / Aeonium leucoblepharum var. glandulosum  (Chiovenda) Cufodontis (1969)

Distribution : Yemen, E. Africa, (Ethiopia, Somalia, Kenya, Uganda); ca. 2000 – 3500 m.

分布:也门,东非,(埃塞俄比亚,索马里,肯尼亚,乌干达);约海拔2000 - 3500m地区.

Description (according to IHSP, 2003) :

描述(根据IHSP,2003):

Perennial branched subshrubs to 2 m.

多年生群生亚灌木,成株可达2m.

Branches ascending to decumbent, usually in groups, 7 – 20 mm in diameter, glabrous, smooth.

分枝上升或匍匐,通常群生,直径7 - 20mm,无毛,光滑.

Rosettes 10 – 20 cm in diameter, centre flattened.

莲座直径10 - 20cm,中心生长点附近扁平.

Leaves 5 – 12 x 1.5 – 3-5 cm, 2 – 5 mm thick, oblanceolate- to obovate-spatulate, apically acuminate, basally cuneate, margin with straight or curved cilia (0.4 – 1 mm), glabrate, yellowish-green to dark green, usually reddish variegated along margin.

叶长5 - 12cm,宽1.5 - 3-5cm,厚2 - 5mm,倒披针形至倒卵状匙形,先端渐尖，基部楔形,边缘具直或弯曲的纤毛( 0.4 - 1mm), 光滑,叶呈黄绿色至深绿色,通常叶缘微红有杂色.

Inflorescence 3 – 15 cm, pedicels 1 – 6 mm, puberulent.

花序高3 - 15cm,花梗长1 - 6mm,被微柔毛.

Flowers 7- to 10-merous, sepals sparsely puberulent, petals 6 – 8 x 1.8 – 2.5 mm, elliptic or lanceolate, retuse, yellow, occasionally reddish variegated, filaments glabrous to sparsely puberulent.

花基数7 - 10,萼片疏生柔毛,花瓣长6 - 8 mm,1.8 - 2.5mm,椭圆形或披针形,微凹,呈黄色,有时带红色的杂色,花丝无毛到疏被微柔毛.

Cytology : 2n=36

染色体:2n=36 即 n=18

Note :

附记:

A. leucoblepharum is one of two east African species, the other being A. stuessyi. It "is extremely variable, which is not surprising considering its 1800 km range across a wide variety of isolated mountainous habitats. The species is locally common on rocks and cliffs  at 200 – 3500m. Many of its known habitats are in isolated moist and forested mountain ranges which rise up out of the surrounding semi-arid and desert habitats.

A. leucoblepharum can be erect to 2 m or almost stemless and densely clumping." (Rudolf Schulz :"Aeonium in habitat and cultivation", 2007, p. 136 – 137)

Aeonium leucoblepharum一至两东非品种，另一个是Aeonium stuessyi .它"是一个变数极大的品种,这并不奇怪,尤其是考虑到在各种不同的孤立的山地栖息地及其1800公里范围.该品种是在海拔200 - 3500米的岩石和峭壁常见的.它的许多已知的栖息地是孤立的半干旱地区,沙漠栖息地,潮湿的森林和山脉.

Aeonium leucoblepharum可直立到2米或几乎无茎抑或浓密丛生" (鲁道夫·舒尔茨: " 2007 Aeonium的栖息地和栽培学",第136 - 137页)

Aeonium leucoblepharum 开花至主头死亡,再到主头处萌发新芽的过程.

Photos Bouke Clement

一颗参赛级的冬炎.

©Pseudolithos

©alloe.

©carlesjbox

Aeonium leucoblepharum var. leucoblepharum 

©Eric Hunt

©FarOutFlora

©KarlGercens

冬季的冬炎.

©landruc

©succulentville80

Aeonium leucoblepharum 冬炎 ,色彩艳丽,枝干狂放,充满野性气质,而园艺种植下优雅大气,不失为小型种Aeonium中的精品.

多肉植物||17.content:
Aeonium lindleyi - 千种多肉植物图鉴 - 梦桑阁

Aeonium lindleyi

LINDLEYI Webb & Berthelot, 1840
 Synonyms :
 异名:
 Sempervivum lindleyi  (Webb & Berthelot) Webb ex Christ (1888) / Sempervivum tortuosum var. lindleyi (Webb & Berthelot) Kuntze (1891)
 Distribution : Canary Islands
 分布:加那利群岛
 2 varieties :
 名下有2个变种:
 Aeonium lindleyi var. lindleyi 登天乐
 Aeonium lindleyi var. viscatum (Bolle) Liu (1989)  璇铃子

P.S.该种为原始种,习性与变种相近,本帖主要介绍其变种.

-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 LINDLEYI var. LINDLEYI 登天乐

©Liz21UK
 Distribution : Canary Islands (NE Tenerife); to 1000 m but most common between 200 and 500 m.
 分布:加那利群岛(东北部特内里费岛);海拔1000米内区域,但大多数分布于海拔200 - 500m之间的地区.
 Description (according to IHSP, 2003) :
 描述(根据IHSP,2003):
 Perennial densely branched shrublets to 50 cm.
 多年生群生灌木,成株高度可达50cm.
 Branches : 3 - 15 mm diameter puberulent, viscid, smooth, without reticulations.
 分枝:直径3 - 15mm,被微柔毛,有粘性,光滑,无网纹.
 Rosettes : 4 - 9 cm diameter, rather flattish, inner leaves ± erect.
 莲座:直径4 - 9cm,叶尖持平,内叶大致直立.
 Leaves : 2 - 4,5 x 0,6 - 1,6 cm, 5 - 7 mm thick, obovate or obovate-spatulate, apically obtuse, acute, or attenuate, basally cuneate or attenuate, puberulent to distinctly pubescent, viscid, yellowish-green to dark green.
 叶:长2 - 4.5cm,宽0.6 - 1.6cm,厚5 - 7mm,倒卵形或倒卵状匙形,先端钝,锐尖或渐狭,基部楔形或渐狭,叶被微柔毛到明显短柔毛,有粘性,呈黄色绿色到深绿色.
 Inflorescences cymose panicles, floriferous part 2 - 7 x 3 - 9 cm, peduncle 1 - 9 cm, pedicels 1 - 10 mm, puberulent.
 聚伞状圆锥花序,多花,高2 - 7cm,宽3 - 9cm,总花梗长1 - 9cm,花梗长1 - 10mm,被微柔毛.
 Flowers  8 - to 9 – merous, sepals pubescent, petals 5 - 7 x 1,5 - 2 mm, narrowly elliptic or lanceolate, acuminate, yellow, filaments glabrous.
 花基数8 - 9,萼片被短柔毛,花瓣长5 - 7mm,宽1.5 - 2mm,狭椭圆形或披针形,渐尖,呈黄色,花丝无毛.
 Cytology : n=18
 染色体:n=18
 P.S.登天乐有香味.

©scott.zona

Plant in cultivation in the south of France.
 法国南部的植株
 Photos éric Barbier

©Juan Ignacio 1976

©Virata33

©Frank.Ebinger

-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 LINDLEYI var. VISCATUM (Bolle) H.-Y. Liu, 1989 璇铃子

©carlesjbox
 Synonyms :
 异名:
 Aeonium viscatum Bolle (1859) /  Sempervivum viscatum (Bolle) Christ (1888) / Sempervivum tortuosum var. viscatum  (Bolle) Kuntze (1891)
 Distribution : Canary Islands (E Gomera); ± 100 - 900 m.
 分布:加那利群岛(东部戈梅拉岛);海拔大约100 - 900m.
 Differs from var. lindleyi :
 与变种登天乐的不同:
 Leaves 3 - 4 mm thick, with a dense covering of extremely short multicellular hairs (< 0,04 mm).
 也厚3 - 4mm,有密集覆盖的极短的多细胞毛(<0.04mm).
 Flowers 7- to 9-merous, petals 5 - 7 x 1 - 1,5 mm, lanceolate, acuminate.
 花基数7 - 9,花瓣长5 - 7mm,宽1 - 1.5mm,披针形,渐尖.
 Cytology : n=18
 染色体:n=18
 P.S.事实上二者的差别还是非常大的,登天乐的叶形更加圆润,而璇铃子则是纺锤状的叶子.

From:Wikimedia

野境中的璇铃子.
 ©Universität Göttingen

家庭种植的植株.
 ©carlesjbox

From:botany.cz

©cactus-aventures

©Daniel Grobbel-Rank

Aeonium lindleyi 一脉以其圆润可爱,绒毛质感的肥厚叶片和其散发出的怡人香气而闻名.再加上小型种天生所具有的魅力,登天乐和璇铃子都是Aeonium中的小王子,深受Aeonium迷的喜爱.
 另外,他们也是非常出色的亲本,无与伦比的特性让他们的后代都注定是佼佼者.

多肉植物||18.title: Aeonium nobile 镜狮子 - 千种多肉植物图鉴 - 梦桑阁
多肉植物||18.content:
Aeonium nobile 镜狮子 - 千种多肉植物图鉴 - 梦桑阁

 

 

Aeonium nobile 镜狮子

 NOBILE (Praeger) Praeger, 1928 镜狮子

©Daniel Grobbel-Rank

Synonym :

异名:

Sempervivum nobile  Praeger (1925)

Section Megalonium

米格洛纽门(音译)组

Distribution : Canary Islands, La Palma, 0 – 750 m, dry slopes, banks and cliffs.

分布:加那利群岛,拉帕尔马岛,0 - 750m地区,干燥的山坡,河岸和悬崖.

Description (according to IHSP, 2003) :

描述(根据IHSP,2003):

Perennial robust monocarpic solitary rosette.

多年生植物(结一次果,即花后死亡),健壮的莲座状植物.

Stems rather stout, 1 – 3 cm in diameter, glabrous, ± smooth.

茎粗壮,直径1 - 3cm,无毛,大致光滑.

Rosette 25 – 80 cm in diameter, broadly cup-shaped to rather flattish, with inner leaves ± erect.

莲座状叶直径25 - 80cm,大致呈杯状,叶尖大致持平,内叶大致直立.

Leaves 7 – 50 x 4 – 30 cm, 6 – 18 mm thick, obovate, apically acute or acuminate, basally attenuate or occasionally cuneate, often longitudinally folded, glabrate, often viscid when young, lower part of margin occasionally with some few scattered cilia about 0.5 mm long, yellowish-green occasionally reddish or brownish variegated esp. along the margin.

叶片长7 - 50cm,宽2 - 30cm,厚6 - 18mm,倒卵形,先端急尖或渐尖,基部缩小或偶尔楔形,通常纵向折叠,无毛,新叶常具有粘性.叶缘下部和上部常有长0.5mm左右的零星纤毛,叶呈黄绿色,偶尔淡红,叶缘常有褐色等杂色掺杂.

Inflorescence flat-topped to broadly dome-shaped, 20 – 40 x 30 – 60 cm, peduncle 2 – 5 cm, pedicels 1 – 2 mm, puberulent.

平顶状花序,大致呈圆顶形,高20 - 40cm,宽30 -  60cm,总花梗长2 - 5cm,花梗长1 - 2mm,被微柔毛.

Flowers 7- to 9-merous, sepals puberulent, petals 3 – 5 x 1 – 1.5 mm, lanceolate, acuminate, whitish, intensely reddish variegated, filaments glabrous.

花基数7 - 9,萼片被微柔毛,花瓣长3 - 5mm,宽1 - 1.5mm,披针形,渐尖,白色,掺杂有浓烈的红色,花丝无毛.

Cytology : n=18

染色体:n=18

来自Zusung的证件照.不过看起来光照不够呢.

©Zusung

Aeonium nobile在原生地:

©Universität Göttingen

©naturgucker.de

事实上,nobile不像大多数大型Aeonium一样少生甚至不生侧芽.

©FarOutFlora

下面是植栽个人非常喜欢的,转自刀姐(微博@刀之莲台)的一组nobile 镜狮子的写真.

(原地址http://blog.sina.com.cn/s/blog_7d320b9101012xgy.html)

这张图是植栽较较喜欢的.

Aeonium nobile镜狮子是Aeonium中较受玩家欢迎的一种,即使是很多岩牡丹爱好者,也有收藏之心.Aeonium的狂野,奔放,野性之美,在nobile身上体现得淋漓尽致,而其多变的色彩和端正的株型更是迷人!如果说Aeonium balsamiferum香馥是Aeonium中的女神,那么nobile绝对就是Aeonium中的男神.

镜狮子,你绝对值得拥有.另外.nobile的发芽率很高,生长速度也还不错,可以尝试.

 PERCARNEUM (R.P.Murray) Pitard & Proust, 1909 蓬莱阁

©bramwellii

Synonyms :

 异名:

Description (according to IHSP, 2003) :

 描述(根据IHSP.2003):

Perennial few-branched subshrubs to 1 m.

 多年生亚灌木,少分枝,成株高度可达1m.

Branches ascending, 7 - 20 mm in diameter, glabrous, reticulate.

 分枝上升,直径7 - 20mm,无毛,呈网状.

Rosettes 8 - 20 cm in diameter, flattish.

 莲座直径8 - 20cm,叶尖持平.

Leaves 4.5 - 10 x 2 - 4 cm, 3 - 6 mm thick, obovate- to oblanceolate-spatulate, apically acute, caudate, basally cuneate, glaucous, glabrate, margin often weakly denticulate, often with curved cilia (≤ 1 mm), dark green, often reddish variegated along the margin.

 叶长4.5 - 10cm,宽2 - 4cm,厚3 - 6mm,倒卵形至倒披针形,匙形,先端急尖,尾状,基部楔形,被白霜, 叶面光滑,边缘常带弱细齿或弯曲的纤毛( ≤ 1mm) ,呈深绿色,边缘常有红色等杂色.

Inflorescences dome-shaped, 10 - 30 x 10 - 25 cm, peduncle 8 - 20 cm, pedicel 1 - 3 mm, puberulent.

 圆顶形花序,高10 - 30 cm,宽10 - 26cm,总花梗长8 - 20cm,花梗长1 - 3mm,被微柔毛.

Flowers 8- to 10-merous, sepals puberulent, petals 7 – 8 x 1.2 - 1.8 mm, lanceolate, acuminate, whitish, median part pinkish variegated, filaments sparsely puberulent.

 花基数8 - 10,萼片被微柔毛,花瓣长7 - 8mm,宽1.2 - 1.8mm,披针形,渐尖,白色,中间有部分粉红色的杂色,花丝疏生柔毛.

Cytology : n=18

多肉植物||20.content:
Aeonium sedifolium 小人祭 - 千种多肉植物图鉴 - 梦桑阁

 

 

Aeonium sedifolium 小人祭

 SEDIFOLIUM (Webb ex Bolle) Pitard & Proust, 1909 小人祭

"sedifolium"意为"With fleshy foliage(有着肉质叶子的)".

©Liz21UK

Synonyms :

异名:

Aichryson sedifolium  Webb ex Bolle (1859) / Greenovia sedifolium (Webb ex Bolle) Webb ex Christ (1888) / Sempervivum sedifolium  (Webb ex Bolle) Christ (1888)

Sempervivum masferreri  Hillebrand (1881)

Distribution : Canary Islands (Tenerife [Teno], northern La Palma) ; to 1000 m.

分布:加那利群岛(特内里费岛[特诺地区],北部拉帕尔马岛)；海拔1000m内地区.

Description (according to IHSP, 2003) :

描述(根据IHSP,2003):

Perennial densely branched shrublets to 40 cm, branches 1 - 5 mm diameter, sparsely puberulent, viscid, smooth, without reticulations, rosettes 1,4 - 3 cm diameter, rather flattish, inner leaves ± erect, imbricate and forming a globose bud during the dry season.

多年生灌木,分枝密集,成株高度可达40cm,茎干直径1 - 5mm,疏生柔毛,有粘性,光滑,无网纹,莲座直径1.4 - 3cm,大致持平,内叶大致直立状分布,叶覆瓦状排列,并在​​旱季形成球形芽.

Leaves 0,7 - 1,5 x 0,4 - 1 cm, 3 - 5 mm thick, ovate or obovate, glossy, puberulent, viscid, green to yellowish-green, lower face with reddish stripes, variegated with many brownish lines near the apex.

叶长0.7 - 1.5cm,宽0.4 - 1cm,厚3 - 5mm,卵形或倒卵形,有光泽,被微柔毛,有粘性,呈绿色至黄绿色,下表面有淡红色条纹,叶缘与叶尖附近有许多杂色条纹.

Inflorescences lax, floriferous part 2 - 7 x 2 - 5 cm, commonly 6- to 15-flowered, peduncle 2 - 8 cm, pedicels 5 - 16 mm, puberulent.

疏松花絮,多花,高2 - 7cm,宽2 - 5cm,通常6 - 15朵花,总花梗长2 - 8cm,花梗长5 - 17mm,被微柔毛.

Flowers 9- to 11-merous, sepals puberulent, petals 5 - 7 x 2 - 2,5 mm, obovate or oblanceolate, acute or obtuse, yellow, filaments sparsely puberulent.

花基数9 - 11,花萼被微柔毛,花瓣长5 - 7 mm,宽2 - 2.5mm,倒卵形或倒披针形,锐尖或钝尖,呈黄色,花丝疏生柔毛.

Cytology : n = 18

染色体:n = 18

P.S.事实上Aeonium sedifolium 小人祭 在拉帕尔马岛(La Palma)和特内里费岛(Tenerife)的产地种差别是很明显的,主要区分为卵形叶与扁叶.

      我们见到的小人祭,一般是来自于拉帕尔马岛的扁叶小人祭,其背面有许多透明腺体.而来自于特内里费岛的卵叶小人祭叶形如同名字一样"卵形",十分圆润可爱,叶背面仅有一条居中的腺体.

      其实两种小人祭都非常美,只是传统的小人祭对于养功的要求比较高,所以我们很少看见它美好的样子.

Aeonium smithii 静谧莲

 SMITHII (Sims) Webb & Berthelot, 1840 静谧莲

"smithii"意为"Named for Sir James Edward Smith, 18th century English botanist(以詹姆斯爱德华史密斯先生,18世纪英国植物学家命名.),此处据其生长特点拟名为静谧莲.

©surrealsucculents

Synonyms :

异名:

Sempervivum smithii  Sims (1818)

Sempervivum hispicaule  Haworth (1819)

Sempervivum foliosum C. Smith ex Otto (1820)

Section Chrysocome

克丽丝蔻(音译)组

Distribution : Rocks and cliffs most commonly in forest zone; Canary Islands, Tenerife, 150-2150 m.

分布:岩石,峭壁,常见于森林地带;加那利群岛,特内里费岛,海拔150 - 2150m地区.

Description  (according to IHSP, 2003) :

描述(根据IHSP,2003):

Perennial densely branched  shrublets.

多年生密生灌木.

Stems up to 60 cm tall, 0.7-3 cm in diameter, densely hairy (hairs 3 – 8 mm), smooth, without reticulations.

茎可达60cm高,直径0.7 - 3cm,密毛(3 - 8mm),光滑,无网纹.

Rosette 6-15 cm in diameter, rather flattish.

莲座直径6 - 15cm,大致持平.

Leaves 3 – 7 x 1.3 – 3 cm, 1 – 1.5 cm thick, obtrullate, apically acuminate, basally cuneate, glossy above, puberulent, with conspicuous longitudinal brownish tannic stripes esp. on the lower face, margin with conical cilia about 0.3 mm long and some additional hairs (0.1 – 0.5 mm).

叶长3 - 7cm,宽1.3 - 3cm,厚1 - 1.5cm, 先端渐尖,基部楔形,叶面有光泽,被微柔毛,具明显的褐色纵条纹.叶边缘有约0.3mm长的锥形纤毛和一些附加的毛(0.1 - 0.5mm)

Inflorescence : Floriferous part 4 – 15 x 4 – 9 cm, peduncle 4 – 40 cm, pedicels 1 – 9 mm, puberulent.

花序:多花部分高4 - 15cm,宽4 - 8cm,总花梗长4 - 40cm,花梗长1 - 9mm,被微柔毛.

Flowers 8- to 12-merous, sepals puberulent, petals 7 – 9 x 2 – 2.5 mm, lanceolate, acute, yellow, with reddish lines, filaments glabrous.

花基数8 - 12,萼片被微柔毛,花瓣长7 - 9mm,宽2 - 2.5mm,披针形,尖,呈黄色,带红色线条,花丝无毛.

Cytology : n=18

染色体:n=18

分布:加那利群岛(特内里费岛);海拔1900m内地区.

Description (according to IHSP, 2003) :

描述(根据IHSP,2003):

Perennial monocarpic unbranched or rarely few-branched subshrubs to 2 m.

多年生亚灌木,少分枝或不分枝,一果植物,成株可达2m.

Branches ascending, to 6 cm in diameter, glabrous but rough when young, reticulate.

分支上升,直径可达6cm,光滑,但新生时粗糙,有网纹.

Rosettes 15 - 32 cm in diameter, rather flattish.

莲座直径15 - 32cm,大致持平.

Leaves 8 - 22 x 3 – 5.5 cm, 4 - 7 mm thick, obovate-spatulate or oblanceolate, apically acuminate, basally cuneate, glaucous or green, glabrate or puberulent, margin with ± straight cilia (0.5 – 1 mm), yellowish-green to dark green, variously reddish variegated.

叶长8 - 22cm,宽3 - 8.9cm,厚4 - 6mm,倒卵状匙形或倒披针形,先端渐尖,基部楔形,被白霜或绿色, 光滑无毛或者被微柔毛,边缘偶具直毛( 0.5 - 1mm) ,呈黄绿色到深绿色,有各种微红杂色.

Inflorescences domeshaped, 15 - 75 x 10 - 45 cm, peduncle 3 - 15 cm.

穹顶形花序,高15 - 75cm,宽10 - 45cm,总花梗长3 - 15cm.

Flowers 8- to 10-merous, pedicels 2 - 6 mm, glabrous, sepals glabrous, petals 7 - 10 x 1.2 - 2 mm, lanceolate, acuminate, whitish, occasionally reddish variegated, filaments glabrous.

花基数8 - 10,花梗长2 - 6mm,无毛,萼片无毛,花瓣长7 - 10mm,宽1.2 - 2毫mm,披针形,渐尖,白色,偶尔有红杂色,花丝无毛.

Cytology : n=18

染色体:n=18

戈梅拉岛的植株,曾经被认为是Aeonium urbicum 翡翠城,较近被认定为Aeonium appendiculatum附魔莲.

Description (according to IHSP, 2003) :

描述(根据IHSP,2003):

Perennial few-branched subshrubs to 1 m.

多年生少分枝亚灌木.成株高度可达1m.

Branches ascending, usually in groups, 10 - 20 mm in diameter, glabrous, reticulate.

分枝向上生长,通常群生,直径10 - 20mm,无毛,呈网状.

Rosettes 12 - 25 cm in diameter, rather flat, inner leaves ascending.

莲座直径12 - 25cm,十分平坦,内叶向上直立.

Leaves 6 - 12 x 4 - 6 cm, 5 - 8 mm thick, obovate, apically acute, occasionally mucronate, basally cuneate, puberulent, margin with ± straight or slightly curved cilia (0.8 - 1.2mm), green to yellowish-green, often pinkish variegated.

叶长6 - 12cm,宽4 - 6cm,厚5 - 8mm,倒卵形,先端急尖,偶尔有短尖,基部楔形,被微柔毛,边缘具直或稍弯曲的纤毛( 0.8 - 1.2mm),呈绿色至黄绿色,常有粉红色等杂色.

Inflorescences domeshaped, 10 - 30 x 10 - 25 cm, peduncle 5 - 30 cm, pedicels 2 - 4 mm, puberulent.

穹顶状花序,高10 - 30cm,宽10 - 26cm,总花梗长5 - 31cm,花梗长2 - 4mm,被微柔毛.

Flowers 7- to 9-merous, sepals puberulent, petals 10 - 12 x 2 - 2.5 mm, lanceolate, acuminate, whitish, often pinkish or reddish variegated, filaments puberulent.

花基数7 - 9,萼片被微柔毛,花瓣长10 - 12mm,宽2 - 2.5mm,披针形,渐尖,呈白色,粉红色或经常有红色等杂色,花丝被微柔毛.

Description (according to IHSP, 2003) :

描述(根据IHSP,2003):

Perennial few-branched subshrubs to 1 m.

多年生少分枝亚灌木,高度可达1m左右.

Branches ascending, 5 - 20 mm in diameter, glabrous, reticulate.

分枝上升,直径5 - 20mm,无毛,呈网状.

Rosette 8 - 20 cm in diameter, rather flattish.

莲座状叶,直径8 - 20cm,叶尖持平.

叶片长4 - 12cm,宽2 - 5cm,厚4- 8mm,倒卵状匙形,先端尖锐,基部变细或呈楔形,叶被白霜,光滑,深绿色至黄绿色,偶尔会在叶尖附近出现纵向的0.4 - 0.8mm的纤毛.

Inflorescences domeshaped, 15 - 40 x 10 - 35 cm, peduncle 5 - 20 cm, pedicels 2 - 4 mm, puberulent.

穹顶状花序,高15 - 40cm,宽10 - 35cm,总花梗5 - 20cm,花梗长2 - 4cm,被微柔毛.

Flowers 7- to 9-merous, sepals puberulent, petals 7 - 10 x 1.2 - 2 mm, lanceolate, acuminate, whitish, lower face often greenish variegated, filaments sparsely puberulent.

花基数7 - 9,萼片被微柔毛,花瓣长7 - 10mm,宽1.2 - 2mm,披针形,渐尖,发白,花瓣背面通常呈绿色杂色,花丝有稀疏的微柔毛.

Perennials up to 25 cm high when flowering.

Roots fibrous, main branches short

 莲座少数到多数，经常出现走茎，形成直径30 - 50厘米的密集群生。

Inflorescence a terminal elongate thyrse, rarely spike-like and with numerous dichasia, pedicels short, with distinct peduncle 5 - 20 cm long.

Crassula schmidtii 筑波根 - 千种多肉植物图鉴 - 梦桑阁

 

 

Crassula schmidtii 筑波根

 一切权力属于原英文作者，译者不懂植物学，欢迎指正

转载请注明原作者&译者。

原文：ICN

译者：柳下杜拉罕

筑波根SCHMIDTII Regel, 1886 (eng./ fr.)

Synonyms :

异名：

Crassula gracilis  Hort.

Crassula hookeri  Hort.

Crassula impressa  N.E.Brown (1870)

Crassula rubicunda  Hort.

Distribution : South Africa, without known locality.

地理分布：南非，无已知地方（？）

Description :

  描述：

Succulent perennial herb, forming mats.

多年生肉质草本植物，形成垫状。

Stems erect or ascending, 5 - 9 cm high, green as the leaves or  ± purple, covered with recurved hairs.

茎直立或上升，5-9厘米高，叶片绿色或±紫色，被下弯毛。

Radical leaves almost rosulate, oblong or linear-lanceolate or almost linear;

胚根叶近莲座状，长圆形或线形披针形或近线形；

stem leaves linear, opposite, not united; all leaves fleshy, acuminate or almost blunt, dorsiventrally glabrous,  upper surface flat, green, pitted, back surface convex, margins horny and ciliate.

茎叶线形，均在一列，不统一；全部叶肉质，渐尖或近钝，背面无毛，上表面绿色，扁平，凹陷，背面凸，边缘角和具缘毛。

Inflorescences manyflowered, lax, branched, part inflorescences and flowers pedicellate, peduncle and pedicels glabrous.

多花的花序，疏松，分枝，部分花序和花的花梗，花葶和花梗无毛。

Flowers : Sepals not united, linear-lanceolate, acuminate, glabrous but with minutely ciliate margins,petals not united, elliptic-oblong, with a subapical mucro, almost keeled, 1/3 longer than the calyx, first erect, later spreading at the tips, red, base white.

花：萼片不统一，线状披针形，渐尖，无毛但是稍具边缘缘毛，花瓣不统一，椭圆状长圆形，与根尖短尖头，几乎晕倒，1 / 3，长于花萼，第一直立，后来蔓延在提示，红色，基部白色。

Flowering time : Winter to spring

花期：冬季至春季

Note:

注：

According to Tölken (Flora of Southern Africa, 1985, p. 229) "a species insufficiently known .... C. schmidtiiis very similar to and probably based on a horticultural form of C. exilis subsp. cooperi as it does not agree with any of the forms recorded from the natural habitat."

根据Tölken（南部非洲的植物，1985，p. 229）；一种了解不够的…C. schmidtiiis非常相似，很可能是源自C. exilis subsp. cooperi 的一个园艺形态。因为它不符合任何形式的自然栖息地的记录。"

Crassula susannae 苏珊乃/漂流岛 - 千种多肉植物图鉴 - 梦桑阁

 

 

Crassula susannae 苏珊乃/漂流岛

 原文来自ICN，青锁龙属 Crassula susannae 词条

翻译：种花小医杂家赵

一切权利属于英文原作者，转载请注明原文链接和译者。欢迎勘误。

SUSANNAE Rau & H.-C. Friedrich, 1962

苏珊乃，由Rau 和 H.-C. Friedrich发表于1962年

Section Argyrophylla

银叶组

（译者注：青锁龙属翻译增加后必然会牵涉到属下分组的概念 这里先暂译一下 待以后修正。    "Argyrophylla"词义为"银叶，银杉"）

Distribution : RSA (Northern Cape: Little Namaqualand); growing on slopes with quartzite gravel.

分布：南非共和国（北角：小纳马夸兰）；生长在石英砾石组成的坡地上。

Description (according to IHSP, 2003) :

形态描述：（根据2003版本IHSP）:

Dwarf, rosulate, with erect 4-ranked leaves but sunken as a whole so that only the upper leaf margins are exposed in nature.

矮生莲座型由以四为基数的竖直叶片组成，但因为整体凹陷（在地面？）所以只有上部的（新）叶片能暴露在外。

Leaves 6 – 10 x 4 – 8 mm, oblong, flat, undulating, upper face flat, lower face slightly convex, epidermis smooth, upper exposed surface papillate, grey-green to brownish, tips truncate, old leaves persistent.

叶长度6到10毫米，宽4到8毫米，长圆形，扁平波浪形，叶片上表面平坦，下面略凸。表皮光滑，叶尖部有小乳突，（叶片）灰绿色到棕色，叶片呈截型（译者注：类似于玉扇，寿的叶片形态），老叶片寿命很长。

Inflorescences cymose capitula with few sessile flowers, peduncle to 3 cm with recurved appressed fine hairs.

聚伞头状花序，着生数量较少的花朵，花梗约3厘米，有内弯的（？）贴伏细毛。

Flowers : Sepals to 2 mm, triangular, with somewhat recurved hairs, margin ciliate, corolla tubular, to 3.5 mm, white, petals fused shortly at the base, oblong-oblanceolate, tips with indistinct dorsal appendage, anthers black.

花萼2mm，三角形，有些许内弯的细毛，边缘有纤毛。花冠管状可有3.5mm长。花白色，花瓣在花冠基部短暂融合，长圆形或倒披针形，尖端背侧有模糊的赘生物。花药黑色。

Flowering time : April - May

花期：四到五月

Distribution and ecology

分布及生态

Growing usually in rock crevices often in exposed positions, from northern Zimbabwe through the mountainous parts of Transvaal, eastern Swaziland and adjoining northern Natal.

通常生长在裸露的岩石缝中，从北部的津巴布韦经过德兰士瓦多山地区，斯威士兰东部和毗邻的北纳塔尔。

Short description (based on Tölken)

简短描述（基于Tölken）

Perennial plants with short erect or decumbent branches up to 25 cm long, slightly woody, with terminal leaf rosettes.

多年生植物，枝条短直立或外倾，长25厘米，稍木质，终端叶莲座状。

Leaves : 2 – 5 (-7) cm long, obovate, rarely oblanceolate, usually rounded, dorsiventrally compressed and slightly convex on both sides, covered with spreading hairs, rarely glabrous, marginal cilia becoming shorter towards leaf base; colour green, grey-green to greyish brown; old leaves persistent.

叶：2-5（-7）厘米，倒卵形，很少倒披针形，通常为圆形，背面扁，两侧稍凸，被平展的毛，很少无毛，边缘纤毛变短于叶基部；绿色，灰绿色至灰褐色；老叶持久不落。

Inflorescence : a terminal flat-topped thyrse with a number of dense dichasia; peduncle (2-) 4 – 10 (-12) cm long; bracts shortly oblong–triangular, apex rounded.

花序：终端平顶聚伞圆锥花序及大量密集的聚伞花序；花序梗（2）4-10（-12）厘米；苞片短椭圆形至三角形，先端圆形。

Flowers : almost sessile; corolla tubular; sepals 1,5 – 2,5 mm long, oblong-triangular, usually bluntly acute, glabrous or covered with spreading hairs and/or marginal cilia, fleshy, green; petals 3 – 5 mm long, oblong to oblong-oblanceolate, acute, with more or less distinct dorsal appendage, tips recurved, white, becoming cream, often tinged pink in bud; anthers yellow to brown.

花：近无柄；花冠管状；萼片1.5-2,5毫米长，长圆状三角形，通常具钝尖，具平展的毛和或边缘纤毛，肉质，绿色无毛或被毛；花瓣3–长5毫米，长圆形到长圆状披针形，急尖，具有更多或更少的不同的背附属物，顶部下弯，白色，成为霜状，花蕾通常微染粉色，花药黄色到棕色。

Photos Judd Kirkel Welwitch, SA

At Walter Sisulu Botanical Gardens, Johannesburg, SA  - a glabrous form with ciliate margins :

very dry :

A completely glabrous form from Pongoland :

Two forms with different leaf colours :

Variegated plants :醉斜阳锦

Ferox Nursery; De Wildt; SA

Photos Jacquie Koutsoudis

Photos Margrit Bischofberger

多肉植物||31.title: Dudleya edulis 仙人宴 - 千种多肉植物图鉴 - 梦桑阁
多肉植物||31.content:
Dudleya edulis 仙人宴 - 千种多肉植物图鉴 - 梦桑阁

 

 

Dudleya edulis 仙人宴

     种名edulis 意思是"可食用的"，当地印第安原住民有采集此种仙女杯的叶子作为蔬菜食用的传统。顺便一提本人已经试吃过了……味道不咋地酸不溜的，大概是晚上积累了景天酸的缘故，建议就不要试吃，只观赏它好了。

    在国内某宝上购买"棒叶仙女杯"也可能得到此种。因棒叶形态仙女杯品种甚众（仙女棒亚属），笼统概以棒叶之名实有不妥。拟定中文名时选取属名的通译"仙女杯"和"可食用的"，引申后取"仙人宴"，拟为中文名。

原文：ICN 仙女杯属 原始种edulis词条

翻译：种花小医杂家赵

一切权利属于英文原作者，转载请注明原文链接和译者。欢迎勘误。

EDULIS (Nuttall) Moran, 1943

仙人宴 ，由Moran发表于1943年

(译者注：Nuttall为原定名人。由于历史原因，仙女杯属的物种曾经被归于景天属，银波锦属，拟石莲属中，较后才由Britton 和 Rose两人提升为独立属，命名法则规定，属名变更后较初定名人标记于括号内 thx秋涵)

Synonyms :

异名：

Sedum edule  Nuttall (1840) 较初的定名 错归入景天属

Cotyledon edulis  (Nuttall) Brewer (1876)  错归入银波锦属

Stylophyllum edule  (Nuttall) Britton & Rose (1903) 即仙女棒属 B&R提出的新属  后被合并入仙女杯属中作为亚属

Echeveria edulis  (Nuttall) Purpus ex A.Berger (1930) 错归入拟石莲属

Subgenus Stylophyllum

仙女棒亚属

Distribution: USA (California: Peninsular Ranges, South Coast), Mexico (North Baja California); rocky slopes, 10 - 750 (-1300) m.

分布：美国（加利福尼亚：半岛山脉，南海岸），墨西哥（下加利福尼亚半岛北部）；生境为岩石坡地，海拔10－750（可达1300米）米范围分布。

Description (according to IHSP, 2003) :

形态描述（根据2003年IHSP）:

Stems mostly erect and short, 1 - 4.5 cm in diameter.

茎大部分情况下直立且很短，直径1到4.5厘米。

Rosettes 5 - 10 (-20) cm in diameter, with ± 10 - 25 leaves, branched and forming cushions up to 50 cm in diameter.

莲座直径5到10（可达20）厘米，叶10片上下到25片， 分枝蔓延成可达50厘米直径的垫状植株。

Leaves densely arranged, linear, ± cylindrical except the base, very acute to acutish, 5 - .20 (-40) x 0.3 - 1 (basally 1.5 - 3) cm, pale green, somewhat glaucous but not farinose.

叶密集排列，线型，大致呈圆柱体形态（基部除外），非常尖锐到急尖 ， 5 - .20 （ -40 ）长0.3 - 1 （基部1.5 - 3 ）厘米宽，淡绿色，叶表面仅稍有白霜，达不到厚粉状。

Inflorescence : Scape 20 - 50 (-70) cm, inflorescence open, elongate, with several (rarely only 2 - 3) 1 - 2x branched spreading scorpioid branches, these 4 - 10 cm, with 3 - 11 flowers, pedicels 0 - 2 mm.

花序：花葶20 - 50 （ -70 ）厘米长，花序多分散、细长，由多分枝蔓延（罕见2 - 3分支 ）的单体或双分枝蝎尾状花序组成 ，分支长4 - 10厘米，着生3 - 11朵花，花梗0 - 2毫米长。

Flowers sometimes slightly scented, calyx 4 - 5 mm, sepals oblong-ovate, acute, usually 2.5 - 4.5 mm, the erect part often overtopping the corolla, petals oblong-lanceolate, apically broadly spreading or ± recurved, acute or mucronate, 7 - 10 x 2 - 3 mm, white, tube 1 - 2 mm, anthers red.

花有时略带香味，花萼4 - 5毫米长，苞片呈长圆状卵形，急尖，通常2.5 - 4.5毫米，直立部分通常超过花冠，花瓣长圆状披针形，花冠顶部平展或略有些下弯，锐尖或短尖，7～10毫米长×2 - 3毫米宽，花瓣白色，花管1 - 2毫米，花药红色。

Flowering time : May to July.

花期：五月到七月

Cytology : n = 17

染色体数：n=17条

A very well-distinguished species, recognizable by pale or light green (not glaucous) terete leaves, open inflorescences with usually several branches, divaricate to somewhat recurved narrow white petals, and divaricate fruits, see Moran (1951a) and Moran (1992a). Natural hybrids are known with D. attenuata ssp. orcuttii, D. blochmaniae ssp. blochmaniae and ssp. brevifolia, D. formosa and D. stolonifera (Moran 1951b).

一个很有特色的物种，浅绿或亮绿色的无霜圆柱形叶片很有辨识度。展开的分枝型花序，平展有时后翘的白色窄细花瓣，和分离的（蓇葖）果。可参见 Moran (1951a)和 Moran (1992a)（的描述？）。和 D. attenuata ssp. orcuttii,D. blochmaniae ssp. blochmaniae 和 ssp. brevifolia，D. formosa 和 D. stolonifera等品种有已知的自然杂交种存在。

多肉植物||32.content:
Dudleya farinosa 火焰杯 - 千种多肉植物图鉴 - 梦桑阁

 

 

Dudleya farinosa 火焰杯

 原文节选自http://www.crassulaceae.ch/index.php?TPL=10120&x270_id=2584

翻译 种花小医杂家赵

FARINOSA (Lindley) Britton & Rose, 1903

曾用名：

Echeveria farinosa  Lindley (1849) / Cotyledon farinosa  (Lindley) Baker (1869)

Echeveria farinulenta  Lemaire (1864)

Dudleya compacta  Rose (1903) / Cotyledon compacta  (Rose) Fedde (1904) / Echeveria compacta  (Rose) A. Berger (1930)

Dudleya eastwoodiae  Rose (1903) / Cotyledon eastwoodiae  (Rose) Fedde (1904) / Echeveria eastwoodiae  (Rose) A. Berger (1930)

Dudleya septentrionalis  Rose (1903) / Cotyledon septentrionalis  (Rose) Fedde (1904) / Echeveria septentrionalis  (Rose) A. Berger (1930)

Subgenus Dudleya ——仙女杯亚属

形态描述（根据 IHSP，2003）：

茎干：修长，直径约1 - 3厘米。

植株：单个莲座的直径约有4 到10厘米，约有15 - 30片叶。常常呈多分枝群生生长。

叶片：呈长卵圆形，叶片前端尖锐。叶片的中部常有一条明显的脊线，脊线在叶片正面和背面都存在。叶片长约2.5 -6厘米，宽约1 - 2.5厘米。叶片分两种形态：被厚粉的、或完全无粉呈现出绿色

【根据这种区别有资料把farinosa分为两种 即Dudleya farinosa（带粉个体）和Dudleya farinosa "green form"（不带粉个体）】。

花序：花葶长约10 - 35厘米，花在花序上分布密集，在顶端集中开花。花序直径4 到8厘米，常独生。有时单个花序上会产生三到五个稍细的（1 - 3.5厘米）蝎尾形分支。分支后每个花序3 - 11朵花，单花的花梗长1 - 3（-5）毫米。

花：花萼直径5 ​​- 8毫米，单个萼片三角状卵形，尖锐，3 - 7毫米长。花瓣倒披针形，花瓣是互相分离的（仙女杯亚属的特征哦~），花瓣长10 - 14毫米，宽3 - 5毫米，淡黄色，花管（原文"tube"不会翻译了…）长1 - 2毫米，花瓣尖端尖锐，逐渐过渡到钝圆。

细胞学检查：染色体数= 17

常常与D. pulverulenta（仙女杯"雪山"）形成自然杂交后代。

英文版原文摘录如下，欢迎勘误：

Description (according to IHSP, 2003) :

Stems often elongate, 1 – 3 cm in diameter.

Rosettes 4 – 10 cm in diameter, with 15 – 30 leaves, mostly much-branched.

Leaves oblong-ovate, apically acute, usually with a clear keel ± in the middle and smaller keels on either side, 2.5 – 6 x 1 – 2.5 cm, strongly farinose or green.

Inflorescences : Scape 10 – 35 cm, inflorescences usually rather dense, flat-topped, 4 – 8 cm in diameter, with 3 – 5 not or 1x branched scorpioid branches, these 1 – 3.5 cm, with 3 – 11 flowers, pedicels 1 – 3 (-5) mm.

Flowers : Calyx 5 – 8 mm, sepals triangular-ovate, acute, 3 – 7 mm, petals oblanceolate, mostly not touching each other laterally, 10 – 14 x 3 – 5 mm, pale yellow, tube 1 – 2 mm, lobes apically sometimes ± spreading, acute to obtuse.

Cytology : n = 17

Forms natural hybrids with D. pulverulenta.

Thompson's "septentrionalis" form (汤普逊的"北方"种)

Photo Steve Mudge

多肉植物||34.content:
E. calderoniae 狂刃 - 千种多肉植物图鉴 - 梦桑阁

 

 

E. calderoniae 狂刃

 原文：http://www.crassulaceae.ch/index.php?TPL=113&x270_id=1134&x270_listsearch=1

图文：ICN & Flickr

（一切权利归原作者 \ 转载请注明出处）

（译注：原拉丁名calderoniae为"刺猬"之意。此莲株形独特，与其他E属或端庄、或奇崛、或古朴的外形有很大区别，而呈现一种矫健灵动、桀骜不驯的美；结合其株形、叶形和拉丁种名发音，拟名"狂刃"。另：此种在欧洲引种较早，栽培者也不少，但未有其任何变种或交配种的记录可查，这对E属算是比较有趣的现象）

CALDERONIAE Pérez-Calix, 1997

由植物学家Pérez-Calix在1997年命名

Series Secundae \ 七福神系

Distribution :  Mexico (Guanajuato)

分布：墨西哥（瓜纳华托州）

Description \ 描述 (according \ 根据 to IHSP 2003) :

Stem nearly lacking, branching. Rosette ± 12 cm in diameter. Leaves 20 – 30, lanceolate to narrow - oblongate, acute, with a reddish mucro, 2 – 6 x 0.5 – 0.9 cm wide in the middle, 2 – 4 mm thick, green, reddish in age. Inflorescence a cincinnus 6 – 12 cm long, pedicels 3 – 9 mm. Flowers : Sepals ascending, 3.5 – 10 mm, corolla 8 – 12 mm, 3 – 6 mm in diameter at base, reddish or orange below, yellow above.

近乎无茎，多分生。莲座直径 ±12厘米。叶量 20 - 30片，披针形至狭长圆形，远端急尖，叶尖微红；叶长2 - 6厘米 x 宽0.5 - 0.9厘米，中部稍宽，厚2 - 4毫米；叶色绿，随成株略变红。倒蝎尾花序，6 - 13厘米；花梗长3 - 9毫米。花：萼片立生，3.5 - 10mm，花冠8 - 12毫米，基部径宽3 - 6毫米；红红色，或基部橙色+上部黄色。

多肉植物||35.content:
E. cante 广寒宫 - 千种多肉植物图鉴 - 梦桑阁

 

 

E. cante 广寒宫

 Echeveria cante 广寒宫

原文：http://crassulaceae.ch/index.php?TPL=10122&x270_id=1189

翻译：Qiuhan

转载请注明原文链接和译者。译者不懂植物学，欢迎勘误。

CANTE Glass & Mendoza-Garcia, 1997

广寒宫，由Glass和Mendoza-Garcia发表于1997年

Series Gibbiflorae

Gibbiflorae系

Distribution : Mexico (Zacatecas)

分布于墨西哥的萨卡特卡斯州

Description (according to IHSP, 2003) :

描述（根据2003年的IHSP）：

Stems to 10 cm tall, 2 – 3 cm in diameter, not branching.

茎部：能长到10cm高，2-3厘米直径，不分枝。

Rosette to 40 cm in diameter

莲座：约40cm直径。

Leaves oblong-obovate, acute, to 18,5 x 7,2 cm, 6 mm thick, upper face flat to concave, thickly white-pruinose, sometimes tinged lavender, margin reddish.

叶子：椭圆形或倒卵形，窄，能长到18.5x7.2cm的长宽，6mm厚，上表面是平的或凹面的，覆有一层厚厚的白霜，有时显现淡淡的薰衣草色，叶缘发红。

Inflorescences 1 or 2, all parts pruinose, cymose-paniculate, 45 – 60 cm, ±1 cm in diameter near the base, branches ± 5, each with 4 – 12 flowers, pedicels 2 – 7 (-17) mm, to 4 mm in diameter.

花序：1-2根，部分覆有白霜，聚伞状圆锥花序，45-60cm高，基部1cm左右直径，约有5个左右分枝，每枝上4-12朵花，花梗月2-7（或17）mm长，4mm直径。

Flowers : Sepals ascending, 10 – 15 mm ; corolla 20 mm, 10 – 15 mm in diameter near the base, exterior pruinose, orange-pink, nectar scales yellowish tinged pink.

花：萼片竖直，10-15mm；花冠22mm，基部10-15mm直径，外覆白霜，粉橙色，蜜腺鳞片为淡黄色略带粉色。

Cytology : n = 27

染色体：n=27

Plants in habitat in Mexico :

墨西哥原产地上的植株：

Photos Gerhard K?hres

Sierra Chapultepec, Zacatecas, Mexico :

Photo Dieter Felix

Photo Emmanuelle Aubé

Photos Rudolf Zacher

ICN旧站上的相关条目（http://crassulaceae.net/echeveri ... veria-listings-c-uk，by James Low）

CANTE (Glass & Mendoza, 1997), of central Mex., a long known but improperly named species, related to Ech. subrigida; name 'cante' is American Indian for "life-water"; published in CSSA Journ. Sept. 1997; now in new Series 5 (Gibbiflorae) in 2003 Lexicon; cytology: n=27(?), main stem to 10 cm tall, not branching, rosettes quite wide to 40 cm. dia, leaves heavily white frosted (pruinose) tinged lavender with reddish margin, inflorescences cymose, from 45 to 60 cm tall and pruinose, flowers orange-pink. This species was long confused with Ech. subrigida which has several minor details of difference.

=*Ech. cante [Glass & Mendoza, 1997], current. = "false Ech. subrigida of Zacatecas" (name used by some growers since 1930s).

广寒宫，由Glass和Mendoza发表于1997年，分布于墨西哥中部，是一个久负盛名的品种，但一直被冠以不当的名字，比如E. subrigida（刚叶莲）；'cante'在美国印第安人之中意为"生命之水"；发表于1997年九月号的CSSA Journ.；根据2003年的Lexicon中，目前属于系列5（Gibbiflorae系）；n=27（持疑）；主干10cm高，不分枝；莲座直径能长大40cm之大，叶子上覆有厚厚的白霜，发淡紫色，叶缘发红；聚伞状花序，45-60cm高，花朵覆霜，粉橙色。这个品种常常和E. subrigida（刚叶莲）混淆，但二者之间有一些细微的不同。

E. decora 德克拉\饰莲 - 千种多肉植物图鉴 - 梦桑阁

 

 

E. decora 德克拉\饰莲

 德克拉 \ 饰莲(台译)

Decora '데코라'

以下原文来自 International Crassulaceae Network

作者 International Crassulaceae Network（引言）& J. C. 范柯培尔（描述）

翻译 horse2000

引言

A somatic mutant of E. 'Metallica' – NOT E. gibbiflora 'Metallica' !

它是拟石莲花属 \ 铁石莲花的变种，而不是拟石莲花属 \ 粉叶莲的变种！

Origin unknown, introduced by Mrs. V. Debergue and Sons, Cambrai, Northern France.

由法国北部康布雷镇的"冯•德柏尔克女士母子公司"(园艺公司)引进。原产地不详。

First published with a short description by Emile Rodigas in : L'illustration Horticole 30 : 185, p. 505, 1883.

此品种首次见诸书端，是在1883年埃米尔•罗迪格斯所绘并出版的《园艺插图》，第505页。

Distributed in UK under the wrong name "E. 'Meynenii' by J. C. van Keppel.

在英国以"拟石莲属 \ 美奈霓"的误名广泛引种

描述

Habit caulescent.

形态 地上茎。

Stem 20 – 60 cm long in older plants, 20 – 30 mm thick, erect, with a dense rosette on top.

茎干 成年株拥有20 - 60厘米长的直立茎干，径宽20 - 30毫米，密集的莲座于顶端着生。

Rosette 10 – 20 cm in diameter.

莲座  直径10 – 20厘米

Leaves fleshy, 10 – 15mm thick, erect, later spreading, obovate, 4 – 10 cm long, 2 – 5 cm broad, margins irregular, most whitish or pinkish, apiculate, underside convex, upper side often deeply channeled, colour marbled green, whitish and pinkish, sometimes striped.

叶片 肉质，10 – 15毫米厚，先直立，而后外展，倒卵形，4 - 10厘米长，2 - 5 cm宽；叶外缘不规则，颜色大多数泛白或粉红，叶端具细尖；叶面底部凸，上部常深内凹，叶片大理石绿色为主，夹杂白色和粉红色，常具拉丝锦纹。

Inflorescences 20 – 40 cm long, 1 – 1.5 cm thick, often marbled, at first spreading, later erect, bracts many in a loose rosette, smaller than in the main rosette but of the same colour; flowers in a raceme of short cincinni with 1 – 5 flowers each, pedicels short.

花序 花茎20 - 40厘米长，1 - 1.5厘米厚，大理石纹路，先外展，而后直立，若干苞片着生在一个小型松散莲座中，此花茎莲座较主叶面莲座小，但颜色一致；短蝎尾花序，为1 - 5朵构成，花梗短。

Flowers : Sepals unequal, widespreading at anthesis, 3 – 10 mm long, shining reddish before flowering, later variegated, corolla pinkish outside, yellowish inside, 10 mm long and wide, tips not strong, curving outwards, stigmas reddish, anthers sterile.

花 萼片不平，花期向后打开，3 - 10毫米长，开花前带有醒目的红色，而后变为杂色；花冠外呈粉红，内为黄色，长10毫米，宽，瓣尖较薄，向外微翻，柱头微红色，花药不育。

又：花车为E. hoveyi，不是德克拉。

关于两者的区别ICN是这样描述的：

The parents are the same as for Echeveria 'Lola' but the mother plant for 'Lola' is Echeveria lilacina.

E. 'Derenceana' and E. 'Lola' are fairly similar. Differences in young plants often are not distinct, and the flowers of both hybrids are the same. Older plants can be distinguished because of their size - the rosette of E. 'Lola' is larger and more open than that of E. 'Derenceana'.

（译者的想法：

1.感觉国内的大部分露娜莲其实是E. 'Derenceana'？ 因为从文中可知露娜莲的体量基本和丽娜是一致的 而我观察到各个版本的的露娜尺寸相对迷你

E.globuliflora 珠花莲

 翻译：种花小医杂家赵

原文来自ICN-echeveria条目-原始种globuliflora词条

一切权利属于英文原作者，转载请注明原文链接和译者。欢迎勘误。

种名"globuliflora"来源于拉丁语,意为"小球形的花朵"。拟中文名为"珠花莲"，本文感谢刀之莲台提供植株图片。

GLOBULIFLORA Walther, 1959

珠花莲，由 Walther发表于1959年

Series Nudae

蜡牡丹系

Distribution: Mexico (Oaxaca Tehuantepec, Cerro Jilotepec) ± 2100 m.

分布：墨西哥(Oaxaca Tehuantepec, Cerro Jilotepec)， 海拔± 2100 m.

Description (according to IHSP, 2003):

描述（根据IHSP，2003版本）：

Stem to 10 cm long or more, sparsely branching.

茎长10厘米或以上，分枝较松散。

Leaves subrosulate, oblong-oblanceolate to obovate-cuneate, mucronate, acute or shortly acuminate, ± 5- 1,5 cm, green, lower face, edges and keel reddish.

叶近乎排列为莲座型，倒披针形长圆形或倒卵形楔形叶片，具短尖，锐尖或短渐尖，±5厘米长 1.5厘米宽，叶片绿色，叶片下表面、叶边缘和叶中脊线红色。

Inflorescences irregularly cymose-paniculate, to 25 cm long, lower branches few, short, each with 2 – 6 flowers, pedicels to 1 cm or more.

花序：圆锥状不规则，长25厘米，下部分枝少，短，每个花序2–6花，花梗1厘米或更长一些。

Flowers: Sepals strongly ascending to appressed, longest 4 – 5 mm, corolla globose-urceolate, pentagonal, to 10 x 8 mm in diameter, petals apiculate, orange -red.

花：萼片紧密贴合在花上，较长约4-5毫米，花冠球瓮形，（正面观）五边形，10×8毫米直径，花瓣尖细，橘红色。

Cytology : n= 42

细胞学检查：染色体数=42

Note :

注释

-        Whether Fig. 144 and 145 in Pilbeam's book " Echeveria" show the correct plant is rather doubtful.

          Pilbeam的著作《拟石莲属》中的图144和145是否是正确的图示非常可疑。

-        And the 2 photos by Julia Etter & Martin Kristen of a plant in cultivation show X Cremneria ′Expatriata′:

         由朱丽亚埃特和马丁克里斯汀栽培的植物的两张照片展示的其实是X cremneria′expatriata′

E.leucotricha 白兔耳及其杂交种

 写在较前面的话：

因为名字的关系，这个品种长期和月兔耳 千兔耳 黑兔耳 福兔耳 火星兔子等品种混杂，但其实白兔耳是拟石莲属的植物 ，月兔耳 黑兔耳等品种是伽蓝菜属植物，火星兔子是青锁龙属的。

原文：http://www.crassulaceae.ch/index.php?TPL=113&x270_id=1431&x270_listsearch=1

翻译：种花小医杂家赵

一切权利属于英文原作者，转载请注明原文链接和译者。欢迎勘误。

LEUCOTRICHA Purpus, 1914

Series Echeveria

拟石莲系

Distribution: Mexico (Puebla: Cerro del Castillo, Caltepec)

分布地：墨西哥 (Puebla: Cerro del Castillo, Caltepec)

Description (according to IHSP, 2003) :

形态描述（根据IHSP 2003版）：

Stem to 15 cm tall or more, 12 – 15 cm in diameter.

茎干：高15厘米以上，（单个莲座）约有12 - 15厘米直径。

Leaves laxly subrosulate, oblong-oblanceolate, obtuse, mucronate, 5 – 8 x 2 – 2,8 cm, 10 – 13 mm thick, green but densely covered with white hairs, with brown hairs at the tip.

叶片：排列疏松，近莲座形。叶长圆状倒披针形，钝，有短尖，长5 - 8厘米，宽2 - 2,8厘米，厚度10 - 14毫米。叶色绿，密被白色茸毛，尖端的绒毛呈棕色。

Inflorescences subspicate to subpaniculate, to 40 cm, pedicels short, mostly single-flowered.

花序：近似于穗状花序或圆锥花序，高可达40厘米，花梗短，多为单花。

Flowers: Sepals appressed, to 10 mm, corolla to 18 x 8 mm in diameter near the base, 7 mm in diameter at the mouth, red.

花：萼片贴伏，10毫米，花冠基部附近直径18×8毫米，花冠直径7毫米，花红色。

Cytology : n = 38

细胞学检测：染色体数=38

Photo Emmanuelle Aubé

Photos Noelene Tomlinson

Photos Margrit Bischofberger

Photo Dick Wright

Photo Dick Wright

Photos Bev Spiller

Created by / Créée par G. Fuge

由G. Fuge培育

多肉植物||42.content:
E.pulvinata 锦晃星 及其真假、杂交 - 千种多肉植物图鉴 - 梦桑阁

 

 

E.pulvinata 锦晃星 及其真假、杂交

 一、Echeveria pulvinata 锦晃星

原文：http://www.crassulaceae.ch/index.php?TPL=10122&x270_id=1696 翻译：Qiuhan

一切权利属于英文原作者，转载请注明原文链接和译者，欢迎勘误。 Echeveria pulvinata Rose, 1903 锦晃星/绒毛掌，由Rose发表于1903年Synonym : Cotyledon pulvinata  (Rose)  Hooker fil. (1903)

异名 ：Cotyledon pulvinata  (Rose)  Hooker fil. (1903)

Distribution : Mexico (Oaxaca) 分布于墨西哥Oaxaca州 Description (according to IHSP, 2003) :

描述（根据2003年IHSP）：

Plants entirely hirsute except inside flowers.

除了花朵内部之外，整株植物被毛。

Stem to 10 cm tall or more, branching. 茎：可高达10cm以上，易分枝。 Leaves subrosulate, obovate, mucronate, 3.5 – 7 x 2 – 2.5 cm, 6 – 7 mm thick, green but densely covered with white or reddish hairs. 叶：近似于莲座状排列，倒卵形，有短尖，3.5-7cm长，2-2.5cm宽，6-7mm厚，绿色，但被有茂密的白色或淡红色毛。 Inflorescences spicate to racemose, or subpaniculate below, to 12 cm tall, pedicels 1 – 1.5 cm, the lowest often with 2 or more flowers.

花序：穗状花序-总状花序，底部可能为亚圆锥花序，可高达12cm，花梗1-1.5cm，底部的花梗上常有2朵或更多的花。 Flowers : Sepals appressed, < ? as long as corolla, to 12 mm, corolla to 16 x 9 mm in diameter near the base, 7 – 12 mm in diameter at the mouth, red. 花：萼片紧贴花瓣，长度小于花冠的1/2，可达12mm；花冠16cm高，基部直径9mm，开口处直径约7-12mm，开口处红色。

Cytology : n = 23

染色体：n=23

Plants in habitat : 栖息地上的植株：

Photos Mieke Geuens

Plants in cultivation : 人工养殖的植株：

An attractive white-haired form, 'Frosty', was found by A. Lau at San Miguel Maninaltepec (Oaxaca) :

一个引人入胜的白毛形态：雪晃星(Echeveria pulvinata 'Frosty')，由A. Lau在Oaxaca州的San Miguel Maninaltepec发现:

Photos Bernie DeChant There is also a crested form : 雪晃星的缀化形态：

Echeveria pulvinata 'Ruby' (选育的锦晃星'Ruby'，同样条件下其红边总是比锦晃星原始种更明显，怀疑园艺市场上流行的应该都是'Ruby'）

Photos Margrit Bischofberger

Photos Christophe Camassel

二、真假锦晃星

1.国内市面上卖的锦晃星多为Echeveria 'Leucaria'柳卡利娅(以白兔耳为母本的杂交品种)或者Echeveria 'Pulv-Oliver' 锦之司（锦晃星x花司） 2.国内卖的绒毛掌确实有的是Echeveria pulvinata

3.但国内（尤其是网络上）锦晃星和绒毛掌是混着卖的，也就是说，即便奔着"绒毛掌"买也很有可能买到的是柳卡利娅或者锦之司 4.柳卡利娅和锦晃星的区别有二，一是锦晃星的叶子略厚，而柳卡利娅的叶子更明显地从中对折、叶缘上翻（较像白兔耳），但实际上即便是同一物种不同植株间的叶子差异也很大，这个特征作为鉴别的方法并不可靠。而锦之司和锦晃星的叶子几乎没有差异。

5. 三者间的第二个区别是花，这也是唯一能够确切鉴别这三种植物的方法。 Eceveria pulvinata锦晃星的花萼紧贴花瓣，如图

Echeveria 'Leucaria'柳卡利娅和Echeveria 'Pulv-Oliver' 锦之司的花萼是摊开的，且锦之司的苞叶更大、更多，如图

柳卡利娅，Photos Bev Spiller

锦之司，Photos Bernie DeChant

简单吧~（除了要等开花……）

三、Echeveria pulvinata锦晃星的杂交后代

Echeveria 'Bombycina'，白闪冠

亲本：E. setosa 锦司晃 x E. pulvinata 锦晃星

Photo Margrit Bischofberger

Echeveria 'Doris Taylor'，桃乐丝•泰勒

亲本：E. pulvinata 'Ruby'锦晃星'Ruby' x E. setosa 锦司晃

Photos Margrit Bischofberger 桃乐丝•泰勒与白闪冠的父母本相反，形态略有差异，下图左为桃乐丝•泰勒，右为白闪冠

Photos Emmanuelle Aubé

Echeveria 'Morvan'，莫凡

亲本：E. pulvinata 'Frosty' 雪晃星 x E. 'Hakuhou' 白凤

Echeveria 'Dagda'，达达

亲本：E. pulvinata 'Frosty' 雪晃星 x E. runyonii 'Topsy Turvy' 特玉莲

Photo Margrit Bischofberger

Echeveria 'Pulvicox'，茜晃星 亲本： E. pulvinata 锦晃星 x E. coccinea 茜蝴蝶/可可西里

Photos Ed Dunin-Wasowicz Echeveria 'Graessneri'

亲本：E. derenbergii 静夜 x E. pulvinata 锦晃星

Echeveria 'Kircheriana'，夜之星 亲本：E. derenbergii 静夜 x E. pulvinata 锦晃星 (虽然亲本和 'Graessneri'一样，但她继承了不同的基因，外貌与上一只完全不同）

Photos Emmanuelle Aubé

Photo Werner Geissler

Echeveria 'Pulvi-Carn'，银明晃星 亲本：E. pulvinata 锦晃星 x E. carnicolor 银明色

Photos Emmanuelle Aubé

Echeveria 'Pulv-Oliver'，锦之司 亲本：E. pulvinata 锦晃星 x E. harmsii 花司

x Taciveria 'Ruth Bancroft'，露丝夫人 亲本：Tacitus bellus 美丽莲 x Echeveria 'Pulv-Oliver'锦之司

Photos Bernie DeChant （Ruth Bancroft是非常有名的多肉爱好者和园艺学家，创立了Ruth Bancroft Garden，一个非营利多肉花园/苗圃，详见http://ruthbancroftgarden.org/rbgarden/pages/about-history.html)

Echeveria 'Pulina'，锦之雪

亲本：E. pulvinata 'Ruby' 锦晃星'Ruby' x E. laui 雪莲

 原文：http://www.crassulaceae.ch/index.php?TPL=10122&x270_id=1911

翻译：Qiuhan

一切权利属于英文原作者，转载请注明原文链接和译者。译者是植物学白痴，欢迎勘误。

Echeveria setosa var. deminuta J. Meyrán, 1989

锦司晃变种：小蓝衣，由J. Meyrán发表于1989年

Synonym : Echeveria rondelii  Hort. Sterk (1989)

异名：Echeveria rondelii  Hort. Sterk (1989)

（译者注：Echeveria tundelii应当也是小蓝衣。tundelii=rundelli，我不知道这一步是误传还是确实是异名，但很多地方都说tundelii also known as rundelli或者rundelli also known as tundelii。而rundelli=rondelii，这一步基本可以肯定是误传，因为rundelli并不是rondelii的异名，但rundelli确实是rondelii，因为几乎所有rundelli的资料都指向rondelii。较后Echeveria rondelii 是E. setosa var. deminuta 的异名。详见http://funjing.com/forum.php?mod ... &page=1#pid3811中的讨论。如有错误还请指出。另外，Echeveria 'Jim Rundell'也是小蓝衣，这个名字很不常见了，出现于这个物种刚被发现并引入商业的时候。）

Series Ciliatae

Ciliatae系

Distribution : Mexico (Oaxaca : Sierra Mixteca)

分布于墨西哥Oaxaca州的Mixteca山脉

Description (according to IHSP, 2003) :

描述（根据2003年IHSP）：

Stem 6 – 8 mm in diameter, copiously branching.

茎部：6-8mm直径，易分枝。

Rosette 2 – 6 (-7) cm in diameter.

莲座：2-6（或7）cm直径。

Leaves oblanceolate, acute, 1 – 3 x 0.4 – 0.9 cm wide above, 1.5 – 5 mm thick, glabrous or commonly with a few white hairs near tip or sometimes on margins or keel, green or at first glaucous.

叶：倒披针形，有尖，1-3cm长，上端0.4-0.9cm宽，1.5-5mm厚；无毛，或顶端有些许白毛，有时白毛也出现在叶缘和脊线上；绿色，新叶可能为灰绿色。

Inflorescences glabrous or somewhat hirsute except inside flowers, 3 – 16 cm long, 1.5 – 3 mm in diameter, cincinni 2- to 7- flowered, pedicels 9 (-27) mm.

花序：无毛或除了花心之外有粗毛；3-16cm长，1.5-3mm直径，蝎尾状花序上2-7朵花；花梗9（-27）mm。

Flowers : Corolla 8 – 12 x 4 – 7 mm in diameter.

花：花冠8-12mm高，4-7mm直径。

Cytology : n = 25

染色体：n=25

Photos Jacquie Koutsoudis, South Africa

 原文来自ICN —— 拟石莲属属下E. subcorymbosa 词条

翻译：种花小医杂家赵

一切权利属于英文原作者，转载请注明原文链接和译者。欢迎勘误。

Series Racemosae.

总状花序系

Distribution : Mexico (Oaxaca :North of Santiago Juxtlahuaca)

分布：墨西哥（瓦哈卡州：Santiago Juxtlahuaca以北）

Description (according to IHSP 2003) :

描述（根据2003年的IHSP）：

Stem usually < 4 cm long, 5 – 8 mm in diameter.

茎通常短于4厘米，直径5 - 8毫米。

Rosette 4 – 6 cm in diameter.

莲座直径约4到6厘米

Leaves obovate-spatulate, cuspidate, 1,5 – 3 x 0,8 – 2,5 cm wide at the widest part, glaucous bluish-grey, often red-flecked beneath, margins reddish.

叶：倒卵状匙形，尖，1.5 - 3厘米长，0.8 - 2.5厘米宽(在较宽的部分)，叶为带有白霜的蓝灰色，叶背面常有红色斑点，叶缘红色。

Inflorescences:4,5 – 11 cm, racemose but appearing corymbose because of the long lower pedicels, pedicels sub-erect, 1 – 3 cm, the lowest the longest, each with 1 – 3 minute bracts.

花序：4,5 - 11厘米，总状花序，因为下方的花梗较长，故形似伞房花序。花梗直立，1 - 3厘米长。低位的花梗较长，每个花梗有1 - 3个小苞片。

Flowers  3 – 12, sepals slightly ascending, 5 – 11 x 2 – 3 mm, corolla ovoid, pentagonal, 8 – 14 x 6 – 8 mm in diameter, 3 – 4 mm in diameter at the mouth, petals oblong, subobtuse, lower portion reddish-orange, upper part yellow.

花：3 - 12（朵）。萼片稍微上翘，5 - 11毫米长，2 - 3毫米宽。花冠卵圆形，五角形。8 - 14毫米长，花管6 - 8毫米直径，花朵开口3 -4毫米宽。花瓣长圆形，稍钝，近花梗处红橙色，上部黄色。

Cytology : n = 29

细胞学检查：染色体数29

The population from Tlacotepec has much wider leaves and may be deserving of varietal status.

在Tlacotepec分布的subcorymbosa种群有更宽大的叶片，可能足以获得独立物种地位。

E. subcorymbosa Lau 030 in habitat near Laguna Encantada, Oaxaca, Mexico.

Echeveria 'Alba Aloha'阿罗哈

 Echeveria 'Alba Aloha'

原文：http://www.crassulaceae.ch/index.php?TPL=10122&x270_id=2442

翻译：Qiuhan

Parentage : Echeveria tolimanensis x E. subcorymbosa Lau 030

亲本：拟石莲属杜里万莲 x 拟石莲属蓝宝石Lau 030

Created by Brian McDonough

由Brian McDonough培育

Brian explains the name as follows :

Brian对这个名字的解释如下：

"The Alba in this instance is not a reference to a white colour, but to the Gaelic name for Scotland. The Aloha came as a result of the flowers. The wavy, horizontal disposition of the flowering stem reminded me of the arm movements of Hawaiian dancers. Hence 'Alba Aloha' - A Scottish Hello !" 

"这里的Alba（意为'白'）并不是指颜色，而是盖尔语中苏格兰的意思。Aloha（夏威夷语的词汇，代表希望、爱、和平、幸福等）则是指花的形态，那种水平伸展的波浪状花梗让我不禁想起夏威夷舞者舞动的手臂。因此，'Alba Aloha'可以理解为——来自苏格兰的祝福。"

Photos by Brian McDonough

Description (according to IHSP 2003) :

形态描述（根据IHSP2003版）

Stem to 8 cm tall or more, ± 7 mm in diameter.

茎干8厘米高或更高，直径7毫米上下。

Leaves diffuse along the stem or subrosulate, oblanceolate, cuspidate, 3 – 6 x 1 – 2,4 cm, 6 - 8 mm thick, green, margin red.

叶沿茎松散生长或成半莲座型，叶倒披针形，骤尖，3 - 6厘米长1 - 2,4厘米宽，6 - 8毫米厚，绿色，叶缘红。

Inflorescences : racemes 10 – 20 cm, pedicel 15 – 18 mm.

花序：总状花序，10 - 20厘米长，花梗长15 - 18毫米。

Flowers : Sepals strongly ascending, to 11- 18 mm, corolla urceolate, 17 – 22 mm long, sharply 5- angled or 5-winged, scarlet below, yellow at apex.

花：萼片上翘，11 - 19毫米长，花冠壶状，17 - 22毫米长，锋利的五角星形或五边形，基部深红色，口部黄色。

Cytology : n = 17

细胞学检查：染色体数=17

Distributed as ISI 1643 in 1986 with the description : "Forming a small shrublet with dark green leaves, this species puts on a colourful display with its bright orange flowers. .... a plant collected ... by A. Lau at 2200m below Quiotepec, near Yolox, in the Chinanteca Alta, Oaxaca, Mexico; plants grew in humus in crevices of almost perpendicular rock."

作为 ISI1643号植物（1986年）被如此描述："生长为有深绿色叶的小型灌木，这个品种色彩丰富，体现在其明亮的橙色花朵........由A.lau于Quiotepec这个地点的海拔2200米以下收集而来，（这个地点）靠近Yolox，在墨西哥瓦哈卡州的Chinanteca，alta。植株在几乎垂直的岩缝腐殖质中生长。

多肉植物||51.content:
Echeveria bifida 贝飞达 - 千种多肉植物图鉴 - 梦桑阁

 

 

Echeveria bifida 贝飞达

 原文：http://www.crassulaceae.ch/index.php?TPL=10122&x270_id=1098

翻译：Qiuhan

一切权利属于英文原作者，转载请注明原文链接和译者。译者不懂植物学，欢迎勘误。

Echeveria bifida Schlechtendal., 1839

贝飞达，由Schlechtendal.发表于1839年

Synonyms :

异名：

Cotyledon bifida (Schlechtendal) Hemsley (1880)

Echeveria bifurcata Rose (1909)

Echeveria erubescens E. Walther (1972)

Echeveria tenuifolia E. Walther (1972)

Series Angulatae

剑司系

Distribution : Mexico (Hidalgo, Queretaro?)

分布于墨西哥Hidalgo州和Queretaro州（持疑）

Description (according to IHSP 2003) :

描述（根据2003年IHSP）：

Stem to 6 cm tall or more, ±1 – 1,5 cm in diameter, usually unbranched

茎部：6cm或更高，±1-1.5cm直径，茎部通常不分枝。

Rosette 6 – 10 ( - 20 cm) in diameter.

莲座：6-10（-20）cm直径。

Leaves lanceolate to rhomboid-oblanceolate, acuminate, mucronate, 4 -10 x 1 – 2,5 cm, upper face, concave to flat, green to purplish.

叶：披针形到菱形-倒披针形，渐尖，有短尖，4-10cm长，1-2.5cm宽，上表面下凹或平坦，绿色到淡紫色。

Inflorescences single, to 3-branched cincinni, with 6 – 20 flowers, pedicels 1 – 4 (- 8) mm.

花序：独生，较多有3根蝎尾状分枝，6-20朵花，花梗1-4（-8）mm。

Flowers :  Sepals to 15 mm, subterete to terete, spreading to reflexed, corolla 12 – 17 x 9 – 11 mm in diameter at the base, 4 mm in diameter at the mouth, reddish or yellowish below, reddish above.

花：萼片可达15mm，半圆柱型到圆柱形，张开或反折；花冠12-17mm高，基部9-11mm直径，顶部4mm直径；基部淡红色或淡黄色，顶部发红。

Cytology : n = 12

染色体：n=12

Although Walther (1972) recognized 3 other species distinct from E. bifida, all have the same chromosome number and differ in such minor details as stem length, the concavity of the upper leaf face, number of inflorescences branches and length of the pedicels. They all seem better reduced under E. bifida.

尽管Walther曾认为有三种与贝飞达不同的物种（译者注：即Echeveria bifurcata、Echeveria erubescens、Echeveria tenuifolia ，但它们的染色体数目全都相同，且四者之间的差异非常细微，比如茎部的长度、上表面的下凹程度、花序上的分枝数目和花梗的长度。因此，其他三种较好也都归于贝飞达名下。

Note :

请注意：

The flower photo Fig. 39 in Pilbeam "Echeveria", p. 60, by B. Kemble, is misleading : The flower of E. bifurcata (synonym of E. bifida) is pale yellowish in the lower third to half – and not whitish – and pinkish to reddish above – not dark red.

Pilbeam的《Echeveria》一书中第60页上第39幅插图（by B. Kemble）很具有误导性：E. bifurcata（贝飞达的异名）的花下半部分应该是淡黄色的，不是白色，上部应该是淡粉色至淡红色的，不是深红色。

E. bifida, Zimapan, HGO and E. bifida, Sta Maria Mexicano,QRO

多肉植物||52.content:
Echeveria calycosa 金明灭 - 千种多肉植物图鉴 - 梦桑阁

 

 

Echeveria calycosa 金明灭

 翻译：种花小医杂家赵

一切权利属于英文原作者，转载请注明原文链接和译者。欢迎勘误。

    "calycosa"应来源于拉丁语,意为"有翘起苞片的"。草拟中文名时看到出状态的成株图，色调金绿，叶薄纤弱，颇有花姿。如唐朝仕女额上所贴花黄。花黄也称花子，是古代妇女脸部的一种女性额饰，又称额黄、鹅黄、鸭黄、约黄等。它是用彩色光纸、绸罗、云母片、蝉翼、蜻蜒翅乃至鱼骨等为原料，染成金黄、霁红或翠绿等色，剪作花、鸟、鱼等形，粘贴于额头、酒靥、嘴角、鬓边等处。故引唐代温庭筠词《菩萨蛮 小山重叠金明灭》中【金明灭】一词——"额上若隐若现的花黄"，拟为中文名。

CALYCOSA Moran, 1967.

CALYCOSA  由Moran于 1967发表.

Series Valvatae

镊合花系

Distribution : Mexico (Michoacan)

分布地：墨西哥

Description (based on IHSP 2003) :

形态描述，根据2003版IHSP：

Stems < 4cm long.

茎＜4cm长。

Rosette single, 5 – 10 cm in diameter.

莲座单生，直径5–10厘米。

Leaves spatulate, obtuse, slightly mucronate, 2,5 – 5 (-9) x 1,5 - 2,5 (- 3,5) cm, light green.

叶片匙形，钝圆，稍短尖，2,5–5（- 9）厘米长，1.5 - 2（－3）厘米宽，淡绿色。

Inflorescence mostly a single cincinnus, at first nodding, later ascending, to 21 cm long, with conspicuous bracts, imbricate in young inflorescences, pedicels 2 – 5 mm.

花序多为单一蝎尾状聚伞花序，起始处低垂，后平展生长，长可达21厘米，有引人注目的苞片叶，在幼嫩花序上排列为覆瓦状，花梗2到5毫米长。

Flowers : Calyx pink at base, light green above, sepals ascending, very unequal, to 13 mm ; petals valvate ; corolla 7,5 – 10 mm long, yellow above, orange below.

花：花萼基部粉色，上部浅绿色，萼片上翘，大小极为不均，较长约13毫米；花瓣镊合状；花冠7,5–长10毫米，上部黄色，下方为橙色。

Cytology : n = 31

细胞学检查：N = 31

Growing in lichens on shaded vertical rocks.

与地衣伴生在垂直岩壁的背阴处。

Distributed as ISI 964, 1976.

发布于ISI 964，1976。

Note :

The closest relative is E. valvata. Both species have valvate (not imbricate) petals, a bicoloured calyx and comparatively long sepals.

注：

与E. valvata有较近的亲戚关系。两个品种都有有镊合状（不是覆瓦状）的花瓣，双色的花萼和相对较长的萼片。

Photos Mieke Geuens

Photos zusang

Echeveria carnicolor 银明色 - 千种多肉植物图鉴 - 梦桑阁

 

 

Echeveria carnicolor 银明色

 原文：http://crassulaceae.ch/index.php?TPL=10122&x270_id=1100

Echeveria carnicolor E.Morren, 1874

银明色，由E. Morren发表于1874年

Synonym : Cotyledon carnicolor, Baker (1870)

异名：Cotyledon carnicolor, Baker (1870)

Series Racemosae

总状花序系

Distribution : Mexico (Veracruz)

分布于墨西哥的Veracruz州

Description (according to IHSP, 2003) :

描述（根据2003IHSP）：

Stem usually < 6 cm long, 1 – 1,5 cm in diameter, branching.

茎：长度通常小于6cm，1-1.5cm直径，分枝。

Rosette 7 – 10 cm in diameter.

莲座：7-10cm直径

Leaves oblong-oblanceolate, obtuse to subacute, 4 – 7 x 1 – 1,5 cm, 5 – 6 mm thick, densely papillose and glistening, greyish or purplish-green.

叶：椭圆形-倒披针形，叶尖圆润或微尖，4-7cm长，1-1.5cm宽，5-6mm厚；上有密集的乳突，闪亮；灰绿色或紫绿色。

Inflorescences to 15 cm, equilaterally racemose, often basally branching, bracts easily detached and rooting, pedicels to 8 mm.

花序：可达15cm，等边圆锥花序，常从基部分枝；苞叶很容易脱落并发根；花梗8mm。

Flowers : Sepals widely spreading, to 6 mm, corolla sharply pentagonal, to 10 x 6 mm in diameter, salmon-orange above, flesh-colored below.

花：花萼6mm，显著张开；花冠为标准的五边形，可达10mm高、6mm直径，上部为三文鱼肉一样的橙色，下部鲜肉的颜色。

Cytology : n = 18

染色体：n=18

Distinctive because of its slightly glistening papillose leaves and short inflorescence.

因为其闪亮的带乳突的叶子而独一无二，短短的花序也很特别。

Note:

请注意：

According to David Jimeno, plants in the wild are never greyish or bluish-grey like the plants in our collections.

根据David Jimeno的说法，野生环境下的银明色并不像人工养殖的植株那样呈现灰色调或蓝灰色。

多肉植物||54.content:
Echeveria chihuahuaensis 吉娃娃 - 千种多肉植物图鉴 - 梦桑阁

 

 

Echeveria chihuahuaensis 吉娃娃

 原文：http://www.crassulaceae.ch/index.php?TPL=10122&x270_id=1205

翻译：Qiuhan

一切权利属于英文原作者，转载请注明原文链接和译者。译者是植物学白痴，欢迎勘误。

Echeveria chihuahuaensis von Poellnitz, 1935

吉娃娃，由von Poellnitz发表于1935年

Series Urbiniae

Urbiniae系

Distribution : Mexico (Sonora, Chihuahua, Durango)

分布于墨西哥的Sonora州、Chihuahua州、Durango州。

Description (according to IHSP, 2003) :

描述（根据2003年IHSP）：

Stem < 5 cm long, ± 1 cm in diameter, rarely branching.

茎：<5cm长，直径1cm左右，茎部很少分枝。

Leaves obovate-oblong to obovate-spatulate or oblong, 4 – 6 x 3 – 4 cm, cuspidate-mucronate, glaucous white to greenish- white, margins and tips reddened.

叶：倒卵形-椭圆形到倒卵形-铲形或椭圆形，4-6cm长，3-4cm宽，具硬尖-短尖；蓝绿色或绿色，被霜；叶缘和叶尖发红。

Inflorescence a cincinnus, 1 – (to 5 -) branched, to 20 cm, pedicels to 14 mm.

花序：单枝蝎尾状聚伞花序，1-5根分叉，可达20cm高；花梗约14mm。

Flowers :  Sepals very unequal, longest ± 8 mm, appressed or ascending ; corolla cylindrical, ± 2 x as long as thick, ± 14 mm long ; petals reddish,

花：萼片大小差异很大，较长的约8mm，紧贴花瓣或竖直；花冠为圆柱形，长14cm左右，约为宽的2倍；花瓣淡红色。

Cytology : n = 26, 50.

染色体：n=26, 50。

The species typically has white-glaucous leaves but, in one population, there were a few plants with dark green leaves.

这个物种通常有着蓝绿色覆白霜的叶子，但某个特定种群有着深绿色的叶子。

Note : The correct name is "chihuahuaensis", not "chihuahuensis" as erroneously indicated in IHSP.

请注意：正确的名字是chihuahuaensis，不是chihuahuensis，IHSP写错了。

Photos Bernie DeChant

Echeveria chihuahuaensis 'Ruby Blush'

Photos Margrit Bischofberger

多肉植物||55.content:
Echeveria colorata 卡罗拉 - 千种多肉植物图鉴 - 梦桑阁

 

 

Echeveria colorata 卡罗拉

 原文：http://www.crassulaceae.ch/index.php?TPL=10122&x270_id=1102

翻译：Qiuhan

一切权利属于英文原作者，转载请注明原文链接和译者。译者是植物学白痴，欢迎勘误。

Echeveria colorata fa. colorata E.Walther, 1972

卡罗拉，由E. Walther发表于1972年

Synonym : Echeveria lindsayana.

异名：林德赛

（译者注：lindsayana已经更名为卡罗拉，林德赛这个名字不应当再出现了。且林德赛不是卡罗拉的亚种/变种/变形，而就是卡罗拉本身。Echeveria colorata 和 Echeveria colorata fa. colorata是一回事，即卡罗拉

Series Urbiniae

Urbiniae系

Distribution Mexico (Jalisco)

分布于墨西哥的Jalisco州

Description (according to IHSP, 2003) :

描述（根据2003年IHSP）：

Stem < 8 cm long, rarely branching.

茎：小于8cm长，茎部很少分枝。

Rosette 13- 20 cm in diameter, with up to 40 leaves.

莲座：13-20cm直径，叶子可达40片。

Leaves ovate to obovate, 5 – 9 x 3 – 5 cm, to 8 mm thick, bluish-glaucous, suffused with red along margins and tip.

叶：卵形或倒卵形，5-9cm长，3-5cm宽，淡蓝色或蓝绿色被霜，叶缘和叶尖红色。

Inflorescences to 30 cm tall, 2- to 3-branched, cincinni to 5 cm, 4- to 6-flowered,  pedicels 5 – 13 mm.

花序：可达30cm高，上有2-3分枝，蝎尾状结构约5cm，4-7朵花，花梗5-13mm。

Flowers : Sepals 1 – 4 mm ; corolla urceolate, 10 – 14 x 6 – 8 mm in diameter ; petals acute to obtuse, reddish or orange near the base, yellow to light orange above.

花：萼片1-4mm；花冠为瓮形，10-14cm高，6-8mm直径；花瓣尖或圆头，基部淡红色或橙色，顶部黄色或浅橙色。

Cytology : n = 27

染色体：n=27

Distributed by ISI n° 496 (1966) and ISI n° 89-49 (1989) as Echeveria lindsayana.

曾作为林德赛出现在1966年ISI上（编号496）和1989年ISI上（编号89-49）。

E. colorata in habitat in Mexico :

墨西哥原产地上的卡罗拉

Photo Gerhard Köhres

Echeveria colorata ISI 496. Photos Bernie DeChant

Photo Emmanuelle Aubé

（译者注：卡罗拉和吉娃娃非常相似，但国内二者的价格却有如云泥。较明显的辨别特征是（1）吉娃娃叶子的顶端有个硬硬的短尖（具硬尖-短尖），而卡罗拉没有此特征/特征不明显；（2）吉娃娃叶尖红，叶缘只是淡淡地泛红，但卡罗拉的叶缘上半部分可以非常红。但是当然了，叶形、叶尖和叶缘的特征即便是相同的物种不同个体间差异也很大，而且不同产地间形态也略有差异，并不能据此100%判断出特定植株的归属。但个人建议，选购卡罗拉的时候还是挑选卡罗拉特征明显的植株吧，某宝上较好选一物一拍的。吉娃娃欢迎讨论。）

（再注：卡罗拉的变种勃兰特Echeveria colorata f. brandtii)

多肉植物||56.content:
Echeveria derenbergii 静夜 - 千种多肉植物图鉴 - 梦桑阁

 

 

Echeveria derenbergii 静夜

 原文：http://www.crassulaceae.ch/index.php?TPL=10122&x270_id=1454

翻译：Qiuhan

一切权利属于英文原作者，转载请注明原文链接和译者。译者是植物学白痴，欢迎勘误。

Echeveria derenbergii J. A. Purpus, 1921

静夜，由J. A. Purpus发表于1921年。

Series Ciliatae

Ciliatae系

Distribution: Mexico (Oaxaca: Sierra de Mixteca)

分布于墨西哥Oaxaca州的Sierra de Mixteca。

Description (according to IHSP, 2003):

描述（根据2003年IHSP）：

Stem short, multibranching.

短茎，易形成多头。

Rosettes  6 – 8 cm in diameter.

莲座：直径约6-8cm。

Leaves obovate-cuneate, mucronate, 3 – 4 x 2 – 2,5 cm, 3 – 5 mm thick, light green, ± glaucous, margins and tips often reddish.

叶：倒卵形或楔形，具短尖，3-4cm长，2-2.5cm宽，3-5mm厚，淡绿色，多少具白霜，叶缘和叶尖通常泛红。

Inflorescences to 4 or more, cincinni to 10 cm, single or sometimes 2, each with 5 or more flowers, pedicels erect, to12 mm.

花序：4根或更多；上有蝎尾状聚伞花序，约10cm，1支，有时2支，每支上有5朵或更多的花；花梗向上，较长达12mm。

Flowers: Sepals ascending to spreading, subequal; corolla erect, 12 – 15 mm long, yellow, keels and tips reddish.

花：萼片向上竖直展开，大小基本相同；花冠向上直立，12-15mm长，黄色，脊线和尖端发红。

Cytology: n = 27

染色体：n=27

Note :

请注意：

In cultivation E. derenbergii rosettes may reach a diameter of more than 10 cm and also grow higher than the description indicates.

园艺中的静夜莲座可以长到10cm以上，茎部也比描述中的更长。

绿体静夜：

Photos Margrit Bischofberger

Photo Stefan Neuwirth
